rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏହି ସୁର Beethoven ଙ୍କ ନବମ ସିମ୍ଫୋନିରୁ ଆସିଛି। ଏଥିରେ C, D, E, F ଓ G ଅଛି, ଓ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସମୟରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ନିକଟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଏ।

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.

rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି, ଧୀରେ: E E F G G F E D।

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତା’ପରେ: C C D E E D D।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · song gtr-2-4 “Ode to Joy” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.

rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ଶେଷରେ ଏକ ଲୟ ଅଛି: ଦୀର୍ଘ ସ୍ୱର, ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର, ତା’ପରେ ଧରିଥିବା ସ୍ୱର। ଏକ-ଓ-ଦୁଇ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଓ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଜୋତା ବାକ୍ସରେ ଚିଠି ହେଉଛି Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ, C ରେ ଏକ ଧୀର ବାଲାଡ୍। ମୁଖଡ଼ା ତାର 1 ଓ 2 ରେ ଅଛି; ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଂଶର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଆନନ୍ଦର ଗୀତର ଦୀର୍ଘ-ଛୋଟ ଲୟ ଅଛି। ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗୀତ, ଗୀତ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 2 · lesson gtr-2-spotlight “Song spotlight: Letters in a Shoebox” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଂଶ: ତାର 2 ରେ C ଓ D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 1 ରେ E, F ଓ G, ଓ ପୁଣି D।

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: A ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, 2 ଓ 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଉପରେ ପାଖାପାଖି ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ରେ ରହେ। ତାର 5 ରୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପାଇଁ ଜାଗା କମ୍ ଲାଗିଲେ ଟିକିଏ ତେରଛା କରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାର 1 କୁ ନ ଛୁଅନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ତାହା ବାଜିବ।

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-4 “A major” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: A ରେ ସବୁ ତିନି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେଉଁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ରହେ?

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: E ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଓ 3 ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ତାର 4 ଓ 3 କୁ ଯାଏ। ତା’ପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2 ରେ ରହେ। ହାତ ଖୁବ୍ କମ୍ ଘୁଞ୍ଚେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଥରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ବାକି ସମୟରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ଠିକ୍ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ବେଗ ପରେ ନିଜେ ବଢ଼ିବ।

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-5 “From E minor to A minor” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇଲେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଓ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବେ ରଖିପାରିବେ। ତାରର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ, ନିମ୍ନରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-6 “From A to E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: A ରୁ E କୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଘୁଞ୍ଚେ। ଉଠାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଭାବନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଏକାସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 5 ଆଡ଼କୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଡ୍ୟାଶବୋର୍ଡରେ ଧୂଳି ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ରେ କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ସଙ୍ଗୀତ। ପ୍ରତି ପଦ ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E ଓ ଦୁଇ A ରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ବଦଳ ଏବେ ଶିଖିଲେ। ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଭାବି ଆଗୁଆ ଘୁଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.translation: ଏହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ କି?

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 3 · lesson gtr-3-spotlight “Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: E ଉପରେ: ଖୋଲା B, ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ।

rows.translation: ହାତରୁ ପାଣି ଝାଡ଼ିବା ପରି ଢିଲା କଚଟି ଓ ଅଗ୍ରବାହୁରୁ ଗତି ଆସୁ। ଟାଣ ହୋଇଥିବା ବାହୁରେ ଶବ୍ଦ କର୍କଶ ହୁଏ।

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଦୁଇ ଭାଗ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ତଳକୁ, ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ: ଏକ ଓ ଦୁଇ ଓ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଆଠ ଝଙ୍କାର।

rows.translation: ସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ତଳକୁ, ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ। ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ହାତ ଥରେ ତଳକୁ ଓ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ।

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-2 “Down and up” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଉପରମୁଖୀ ଝଙ୍କାର ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଭାବେ ମୃଦୁ। ଉପରକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ କେବଳ ପତଳା ତିନି ବା ଚାରି ତାରକୁ ଛୁଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଛନ୍ଦକୁ ଉତ୍ସାହ ଦିଏ।

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ଟିକିଏ ଜୋରରେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଜୋର କୁହାଯାଏ। ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବାକିଠାରୁ ଜୋରରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେଉଁଠି ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ ଜଣାଏ।

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 4 · lesson gtr-4-3 “Accent beat one” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ଝଙ୍କାର ଟିକିଏ ଜୋରରେ କଲେ ଆପଣ ଓ ଶ୍ରୋତା ଠିକ୍ ତାଳରେ ରହନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.

rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ସଂଖ୍ୟା କୁହନ୍ତୁ: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି; ଦୁଇ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି, ଚାରି। କେଉଁଠି ଅଛନ୍ତି ସବୁବେଳେ ଜାଣିବେ।

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.

rows.translation: ଏହି ଇଂରାଜୀ ସୁର 400 ବର୍ଷରୁ ଅଧିକ ପୁରୁଣା। ସବୁ କର୍ଡ ପରିଚିତ: A ମାଇନର୍, C, G, E ମାଇନର୍, F ଓ E। ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଥରେ, ତା’ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ଆଉ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଏ, ଯାହା ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଟାଣେ। D7, G କୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: 2 ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ; 1 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ; 3 ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-4 “D7 and the Clementine chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 1880 ଦଶକର ଏହି ଆମେରିକୀୟ ବାଲାଡ୍ ପାଇଁ କେବଳ G ଓ D7 ଦରକାର। ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ପରି ଏହା ତିନି ମାତ୍ରାରେ। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଥରେ, ତା’ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · song gtr-7-5 “Clementine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କ୍ଲେମେଣ୍ଟାଇନ୍‌ର ସୁର ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ରେ ଅଛି। ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିରେ ପୁଣି F ଶାର୍ପ: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

rows.translation: ଆରମ୍ଭ: G G G, ତଳକୁ ଖୋଲା D, ଉପରକୁ ଖୋଲା B।

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଭୂତ ଆଲୋକ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: ଧୀର, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ବାଲାଡ୍। ପଦ A ମାଇନର୍, F, C ଓ E ରେ ଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଛୋଟ F ଏବେ ଗୀତରେ ବାଜେ। E ର G ଶାର୍ପ ସୁରକୁ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.translation: ବାଲାଡ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ତୃତୀୟରେ ଆଉ ଥରେ, ଚତୁର୍ଥରେ ତଳ-ଉପର। ପ୍ରତି ଝଙ୍କାର ପରର ବିରାମ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗୀତର ଅଂଶ।

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 7 · lesson gtr-7-spotlight “Song spotlight: Ghost Light” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ପଦର ଶେଷ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି: ଖୋଲା B, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ C, B, ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ, B, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା E।

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-2 “G7 and B7” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: B7, E ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ। E ମାଇନର୍ ବା E ରେ ତାହାର ଟାଣ ମେଣ୍ଟେ।

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-3 “The shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଶଫଲ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଅସମାନ ଭାଗ କରେ: ତଳକୁ ଦୀର୍ଘ ଝଙ୍କାର, ଉପରକୁ ଛୋଟ। ଏହା ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ହୃଦସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ। ଭାବନ୍ତୁ ହମ୍-ଟି, ଡମ୍-ଟି।

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅନେକ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଗୀତ ଗୋଟିଏ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଯୋଜନା ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ। E ରେ: ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E7, ଦୁଇ A7, ଦୁଇ E7, ତା’ପରେ B7, A7, E7 ଓ B7 ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଗୋଟିଏ।

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ କେତେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ E7 ଥାଏ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-4 “12-bar blues in E” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଶେଷ ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶୀଘ୍ର ବଦଳେ: B7, A7, E7, ତା’ପରେ B7, ଯାହା ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଏ। ଆଗୁଆ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଶଫଲ୍ ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସସ୍ କର୍ଡ ମେଜର୍ ବା ମାଇନର୍ କରୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପାଖ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ବଦଳାଏ। ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଖୋଲା ଓ ଅମୀମାଂସିତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-5 “Sus chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: Dsus2 ପାଇଁ ତାର 1 ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ। Asus4 ପାଇଁ A ବଜାଇ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଶିଳ୍ପାଞ୍ଚଳର ଶଫଲ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: E ରେ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ଏବେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ଯୋଜନା ଉପରେ ଦୋଳାୟିତ ସୁର। ଦୁଇ ହାତରେ ଦୀର୍ଘ-ଛୋଟ ଲୟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା G, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ G ଶାର୍ପ, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା B: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍।

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ G ରୁ G ଶାର୍ପକୁ ଯାଏ। କେଉଁଟି E7 ରେ ଅଛି?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: E7 ହେଉଛି E, G ଶାର୍ପ, B ଓ D। G ହେଉଛି ବ୍ଲୁ ସ୍ୱର: କର୍ଡ ସହ ଟାଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରି ତା’ପରେ ତାହା ଭିତରକୁ ଖସେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 5 (along) · title

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 8 · lesson gtr-8-spotlight “Song spotlight: Rust Belt Shuffle” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ନବମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, B7 ଉପରେ: ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ, ଖୋଲା E, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ରେ D ଶାର୍ପ, ତା’ପରେ B।

Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ କେବଳ ମୂଳ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷର ଉପରର ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ। ମେଜର୍ ବା ମାଇନର୍ ନୁହେଁ, ଜୋରରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। E5 ହେଉଛି E ମାଇନର୍‌ର ନିମ୍ନ ଅଂଶ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-1 “E5 and A5” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସମାନ ଦୁଇ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 4 ଓ 3 କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର 5 ସହ ଏହା A5। କେବଳ ତାର 5, 4 ଓ 3 ରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-2 “Palm muting” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବଜାଇବା ହାତର ବାହାର ଧାର ତାର ଉପରେ, ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ସହ ମିଳିଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଝଙ୍କାର କଲେ ସ୍ୱର ଛୋଟ ଓ ଠସ୍‌ଠସ୍ ହୁଏ।

rows.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ତାର ବାଜେ, କେବଳ ଛୋଟ ସମୟ ପାଇଁ। ଆଗକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଶବ୍ଦ ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ।

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.

rows.translation: ରକ୍‌ରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡକୁ ଯାଏ। ବଡ଼ ଝଙ୍କାର ପାଇଁ ପାପୁଲି ଉଠାଇ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରିଫ୍ ହେଉଛି ପୁଣି ପୁଣି ବାଜୁଥିବା ଛୋଟ, ମନଛୁଆଁ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ। ଏହା ଖୋଲା ନିମ୍ନ E କୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଫେରେ। ଟାଇଟ୍ ଶବ୍ଦ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ପାପୁଲି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା E, ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତା’ପରେ ଖୋଲା A।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ତାର 5 ରେ ଚଢ଼େ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତା’ପରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ପୁଣି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-4 “Your first riff” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 5: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ପୁଣି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗୀତରେ ରିଫ୍‌କୁ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଆଯାଏ। ରିଫ୍ ବଜାଇ ଏକରେ, ଦୁଇର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଓ ଚାରିରେ କର୍ଡ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-5 “Riffs and power chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.translation: G ରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ କର୍ଡର ନାମ ବଦଳେ।

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତଳଘରର ପାଗ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ରେ ଗ୍ୟାରେଜ୍ ରକ୍। ନିମ୍ନ ତାରର ରିଫ୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ, ତା’ପରେ ଏକ, ଦୁଇର ‘ଓ’ ଓ ଚାରିରେ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ। ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ପାଖରେ ପାପୁଲି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ C, ଖୋଲା D, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 6 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ଓ ଖୋଲା ନିମ୍ନ E।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · lesson gtr-9-spotlight “Song spotlight: Basement Weather” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: C5 ଜାଣିଛନ୍ତି: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ପୂରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇଲେ D5। G5 ମଧ୍ୟ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ, C5 ଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ନିମ୍ନ ତାରରେ।

Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: power chords, open and movable, palm muting and your riff. Lock in with the click and keep the mutes tight.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନୂଆ କିଛି ନାହିଁ: ଖୋଲା ଓ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ, ପାପୁଲିରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ରୋକିବା ଓ ନିଜ ରିଫ୍। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମ୍ୟୁଟ୍ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Your root is on string 5, fret 3. Which power chord is it?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 9 · challenge gtr-9-6 “Riff challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। କେଉଁ ପାୱାର୍ କର୍ଡ?

rows.translation: ତାର 5, A ରୁ ଚଢ଼େ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C।

rows.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 “Barre chords and the pentatonic” · unit summary
rows.translation: F ବାରେ ଓ B ମାଇନର୍, A ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଏକକ ବାଦନ।

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପୂରା ବାରେ କର୍ଡ ଶିଖିବାକୁ କିଛି ସପ୍ତାହ ଲାଗେ, ତେଣୁ ଧୀରେ ଆଗାନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ F ଜାଣିଛନ୍ତି। ପରେ ପାଞ୍ଚ ତାରର F, ତା’ପରେ ପୂରା ବାରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ତାର 5 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପାଞ୍ଚ ତାର ବାଜେ ଓ F ଅଧିକ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ବାରେ କର୍ଡ ପ୍ରଥମେ କଠିନ ଲାଗେ। କ’ଣ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-1 “On the way to F” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଶକ୍ତି ଓ ଅନୁଭବ ଧୀରେ ବଢ଼େ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଲମ୍ବା, କଷ୍ଟଦାୟକ ଅଭ୍ୟାସଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ଦୈନିକ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଭଲ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · title
Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ସବୁ ଛଅ ତାର ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3 ଓ 4 ତା’ଆଗରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ କରେ। F ହେଉଛି E କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେବା।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନେକ୍‌କୁ ଧୀରେ ନିଜ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣିବା ପରି ବାହୁର ଓଜନରେ ବାରେ ଚାପ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କେବଳ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 କୁ ଧାର ଉପରେ କାତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 4 (along) · title

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-2 “The full F barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: F ବାରେ କେଉଁ ଖୋଲା ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ ହୁଏ?

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 1 ରୁ 5 ଚାପେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 3 ଓ 4 ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ କରେ। ତାର 6 ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବାରେ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ନୁହନ୍ତି? କେବଳ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାରି ତାର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ତାର 4 ଓ 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2।

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-3 “B minor” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: E କୁ ବାରେ ସହ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ହୁଏ?

Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ପାଞ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଥାଏ। A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ A, C, D, E ଓ G। ଅସଂଖ୍ୟ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଓ ରକ୍ ଏକକ ବାଦନର ଏହି ଧ୍ୱନି।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ତାରର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଚାପେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ଓ 8 ନିଅନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତି ତାରରେ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର, ପ୍ରତି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-4 “The A minor pentatonic” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 6 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8, ତା’ପରେ ତାର 5 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7।

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 10 · lesson gtr-10-spotlight “Song spotlight: Glass Satellites” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କାଚର ଉପଗ୍ରହ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ମାଇନର୍, F, C ଓ G ରେ ପାୱାର୍ ବାଲାଡ୍। ପୂରା F ବାରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ କର୍ଡ; ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଚକ୍ରରେ ମେଳ ଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏକକ ବାଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତ ଗୀତର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଂଶରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପିକ୍ ବଦଳରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର ଟାଣି ବଜାଇବାକୁ ଫିଙ୍ଗର୍ପିକିଂ କୁହାଯାଏ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବେସ୍ ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 ବଜାଏ, ଏବଂ ବେସ୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତାଳ ଦିଏ।

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-1 “Thumb on the bass” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: କେବଳ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 କୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ତଳକୁ ଠେଲି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତାର 4 ରେ କର୍ଡର ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ମୂଳ, ପଞ୍ଚମ, ମୂଳ, ପଞ୍ଚମ: ଏହା ହେଉଛି ପାଳିକରି ବଜାଯାଉଥିବା ବେସ୍।

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-2 “p, i, m and a” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫିଙ୍ଗର୍ଷ୍ଟାଇଲ୍‌ରେ ସ୍ପାନିଶ୍ ନାମର ଅକ୍ଷର ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ: p ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, i ତର୍ଜନୀ, m ମଧ୍ୟମା, a ଅନାମିକା। ବଜାଇବା ପାଇଁ i କୁ ତାର 3, m କୁ ତାର 2 ଓ a କୁ ତାର 1 ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.

rows.translation: i, m, a: ତର୍ଜନୀ ତାର 3 ରେ, ମଧ୍ୟମା 2 ରେ, ଅନାମିକା 1 ରେ।

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 11 · lesson gtr-11-3 “Travis picking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମର୍ଲ୍ ଟ୍ରାଭିସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ନାମିତ ଟ୍ରାଭିସ୍ ପିକିଂରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପାଳିକରି ବେସ୍ ବଜାଏ; ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଝିର ‘ଓ’ ଗଣନାରେ ତାର ବଜାନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ କର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରଥମ, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା। E ରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ E7, A7 ଓ B7। A କୁ ଗଲେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ A7, D7 ଓ E7 ହୁଏ।

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: E ରେ B7 ର ଯେଉଁ ଭୂମିକା, A ରେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡର ସେହି ଭୂମିକା?

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.

rows.translation: E ଠାରୁ ଅକ୍ଷର ଗଣିଲେ ପଞ୍ଚମରେ B, ତେଣୁ B7। A ଠାରୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ଅକ୍ଷର E, ତେଣୁ E7 ତାହାର ସ୍ଥାନ ନିଏ।

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-1 “The blues in A” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: A7 ର ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ, D7 ର ଦୁଇ, A7 ର ଦୁଇ, ତାପରେ E7, D7, A7 ଓ E7 ର ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଖାଏଁ। ଶେଷ E7 ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଇ ନିଏ।

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.

rows.translation: ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ରେ ଚତୁର୍ଥ କର୍ଡକୁ ଯାଇ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଫେରନ୍ତି। A ରେ: A7, D7, A7, A7। ଏହା ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଗତି ଆଣେ।

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-2 “The quick change” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: A ର ଚତୁର୍ଥ କର୍ଡ D7। ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ରେ ସେଠାକୁ ଯାଇ ପୁଣି A7 କୁ ଫେରନ୍ତି।

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.

rows.translation: ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ହୁଏ। E ରେ: E7, A7, E7, E7। ଶେଷ ପାଖରେ ଚାରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର କର୍ଡ B7 ପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବୁଗି ଧାରା କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ପୁଣି ଫେରେ; ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର, ଶଫଲ୍ ପରି ଲମ୍ବା-ଛୋଟ। A7 ଉପରେ A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G ଯାଏଁ ଉଠି ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ ଫେରେ।

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.

rows.translation: ଖୋଲା A, ତାର 5 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାର 4 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 4, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା G।

rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଯୋଡ଼ିର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ଲୟ କିପରି ଲାଗେ?

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପୁଣି ସେହି ଶଫଲ୍: ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱର, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ମାତ୍ରାର ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱର।

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସେହି ଧାରା ତାର 4 ରେ D ରୁ ଏବଂ ତାର 6 ରେ E ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। D7 ଉପରେ: D, F ଶାର୍ପ, A, B, C। E7 ଉପରେ: E, G ଶାର୍ପ, B, C ଶାର୍ପ, D।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 6 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-3 “A boogie bass line” · step 8 (along) · title
rows.translation: ବୁଗି, A ରୁ D ଓ ପୁଣି ଫେରନ୍ତୁ

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 11 ଓ 12 ରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଟର୍ନ୍‌ଆରାଉଣ୍ଡ ଥାଏ: ଆରମ୍ଭକୁ ଫେରାଇ ନେଉଥିବା ଛୋଟ ଲିକ୍। ଏଠାରେ A ରୁ E ଯାଏଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ କରି ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର।

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 4: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, ତାପରେ 3, ତାପରେ 2। E ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଶେଷ ଦୁଇ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ। ଆଉ ଥରେ ବଜାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଏହା କାନକୁ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 1 କୁ ଫେରାଇ ନିଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-4 “The turnaround” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଦଶ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ସହ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 11 ଓ 12 ରେ ଲିକ୍ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଏଭଳି ପ୍ରତି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ଶେଷ କରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ A ମାଇନର୍ ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ A ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ସହ ଖାପ ଖାଏ। ଏହାର C, A7 ର C ଶାର୍ପ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଏବଂ ସେହି ଘର୍ଷଣ ହିଁ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ଧ୍ୱନି।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: A ର ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ଥିରତା ଦିଏ?

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: A ହେଉଛି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର। A ରେ ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ଲିକ୍ ସ୍ଥିର ଲାଗେ; G ଓ C ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣତାର ଅନୁଭବ ଛାଡ଼େ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-5 “Blues licks in A” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପରସ୍ପର କଥା ହୁଅନ୍ତି। ଲିକ୍ 1 କୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଭାବେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିମ୍ନ A ରେ ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ଲିକ୍ 2 ରେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିଅନ୍ ଆଲୋକର ଲଣ୍ଡ୍ରି ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: ଗୋଟିଏ କର୍ଡ A7 ଉପରେ ଫଙ୍କ୍। ଏହାର ଆକର୍ଷକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ C ରୁ C ଶାର୍ପକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରେ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ଲିକ୍ ପରି ସେହି ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଓ ମୁଖଡ଼ା E7 କୁ ଯାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ର A, ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ଓ 2 ର C ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା E।

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: A7 ଉପରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର କର୍ଡ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: A7 ହେଉଛି A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E ଓ G। ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସର C ଏହାର C ଶାର୍ପ ସହ ଘର୍ଷଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଏବଂ ଆକର୍ଷକ ସ୍ୱରଖଣ୍ଡ ଗୋଟିକରୁ ଅନ୍ୟଟିକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିଅନ୍ ଆଲୋକର ଲଣ୍ଡ୍ରିରେ ଶଫଲ୍ ନାହିଁ। ବୁଗି ଧାରାକୁ ସମାନ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ରେ ବଜାଇଲେ ତାହା A7 ତଳେ ବେସ୍ ଧାରା ହୁଏ: A, C ଶାର୍ପ, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, ଓ ପୁଣି ତଳକୁ।

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · challenge gtr-12-6 “Blues challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: A ଓ E ରେ 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ, ବୁଗି ଧାରା, ଟର୍ନ୍‌ଆରାଉଣ୍ଡ ଓ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଲିକ୍। ଶଫଲ୍‌ର ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଲୟ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.translation: E ରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର କର୍ଡ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 2 ର କର୍ଡ କ’ଣ?

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍‌ରେ କେବଳ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଯାଏ। ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପଛରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରି ଚାଲେ।

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3 ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-1 “Hammer-ons” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଧରି ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍‌ରେ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ଦୁଇଟି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାରରେ ରଖି ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା ବେଳେ ତାର ବଜାଇଦେବ।

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 କୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ି ଖୋଲା G ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-2 “Pull-offs” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 3। ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ଟାଣି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରିବାକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚାପ ବଜାୟ ରଖି ସେହି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ନୂଆ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌କୁ ସରାନ୍ତୁ। ଚାପ ଧ୍ୱନିକୁ ଧରି ରଖେ; କେବଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ପିକ୍ ହୁଏ।

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3। ପିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନଉଠାଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 କୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ ବେଳେ କ’ଣ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବଜାୟ ରଖେ?

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-3 “Slides” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ ଫେରନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ପିକ୍ କରି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 କୁ ତଳକୁ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବେଣ୍ଡ୍‌ରେ ତାରକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ଠେଲି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବଢ଼ାଯାଏ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ବେଣ୍ଡ୍, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ସମାନ ବୃଦ୍ଧି, ଠିକ୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ପରି ଶୁଣାଯିବା ଦରକାର।

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9: ଏହା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍‌ର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର। ଏହାକୁ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦେଇ ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସେହି ତାରରେ ତାହା ପଛରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 2। ଦରଜାର ଗୋଲ ହାତଲ ଘୁରାଇବା ପରି ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ଘୁରାଇ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଛାତ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଠେଲନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9 ଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ଶୁଣାଯାଉଛି। ଏବେ କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.

rows.translation: ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟରେ ନପହଞ୍ଚିଥିବା ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ ବେସୁରା ଲାଗେ। ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ମିଳିବା ଯାଏଁ ଠେଲନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-4 “Bends and vibrato” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ହେଉଛି ଧରି ରଖାଯାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଛୋଟ ବେଣ୍ଡ୍ କରି ଛାଡ଼ିବା, ଯାହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ହୁଏ। ସ୍ୱର ସୁରରେ ରହିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହାକୁ ଅଳ୍ପ ଓ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-5 “Box 2 and the link” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗିଟାରର ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ସେହି ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱର ପୁଣି ଆସେ। ବିନ୍ୟାସ 1 ଶେଷ ହେଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରୁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ 2 ଆରମ୍ଭ: ତାର 5, 4 ଓ 3 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ତାର 6, 2 ଓ 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2।

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 13 · lesson gtr-13-spotlight “Song spotlight: Saltwater Sunday” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଲୁଣିଆ ଜଳର ରବିବାର ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ଆରାମଦାୟକ ରେଗେ, ଯେଉଁଠି Am7 ଓ D7 ପାଳିକରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ନିଅନ୍ତି। ଦୁଇଟି ପେଣ୍ଟାଟୋନିକ୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଳେ। ହାମର୍-ଅନ୍, ପୁଲ୍-ଅଫ୍ ଓ ସ୍ଲାଇଡ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ କର୍ଡର ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 “Moving barre chords” · unit summary
rows.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ E ଓ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ଏବଂ A ରେ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ।

Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ F ବାରେ ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ବାରେ ସହ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ପୂରା ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଉପରକୁ ସରାଇଲେ ତାର 6 ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ନାମ ବଦଳେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A।

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ। କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 6 ରେ E ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 1 ରେ F, 3 ରେ G, 5 ରେ A। ବାରେର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ କର୍ଡର ନାମ ଦିଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-1 “The E shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଉଠାଇ ବାରେକୁ ତାର 3 ଧରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା E ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ଏବଂ ସେହିଭଳି ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A ମାଇନର୍।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · title
rows.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: B ମାଇନର୍ ଥିଲା ବାରେ ସହ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ। A ମେଜର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ: ତାର 1 ରୁ 5 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ। କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ A ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 5 ରେ D।

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · title
rows.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଏ

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-2 “The A shape moves” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ପାଇଁ B ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ: 2, 3 ଓ 4 ବାରେ ଆଗରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଏହା C ମାଇନର୍।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ କର୍ଡ ତାର 6 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ, କିମ୍ବା ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ ହୋଇପାରେ। ହାତ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନର ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଆପଣ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ବଜାଉଛନ୍ତି। ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିକଟ C କେଉଁଠି?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ରହି A ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G ରୁ C କୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ବାରେରେ ରହେ। କେବଳ ତାହା ଆଗର ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବଦଳନ୍ତି। ଏହା ସବୁଠାରୁ ସହଜ ବାରେ ବଦଳ।

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସର D କେଉଁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍‌ରେ ଥାଏ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-3 “E shape or A shape?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 5: ଖୋଲା A, 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 5 ରେ D।

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · title
rows.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, D, A, E

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, D, A ଓ E ସବୁ A ର ଅନ୍ତର୍ଗତ। F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ବାରେ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡ ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: E-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେର F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ…

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 6: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ F, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-4 “F sharp minor, D, A, E” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର D, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସର A, ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର E।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଇବାବେଳେ ବାରେକୁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ନୂଆ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ସବୁବେଳେ ଜୋର୍‌ରେ ଧରିଲେ ହାତ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ହୁଏ ଓ ବଦଳ ଧୀର ହୁଏ।

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ହାତ କେତେବେଳେ ଚାପିବା ଦରକାର?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ସ୍ଥାନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ସରିବାବେଳେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲଗାତାର ବଳ ଲଗାଇଲେ କେତେକ ମିନିଟ୍‌ରେ ହାତ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · title
rows.translation: ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-5 “Smooth barre changes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବଦଳ ପୂର୍ବର ଶେଷ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ବାରେ ଉଠାଇ ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ବାଜେ, ତାଳ ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏନାହିଁ, ଓ ଆପଣ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · title
Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ପ୍ରେ ରଙ୍ଗର ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟୋଦୟ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: E ରେ ଇଣ୍ଡି ପପ୍, E, B, C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A ଉପରେ। B ଓ C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ ଦୁହେଁ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ, ତେଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ହାତ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଅଧିକାଂଶ କାମ କରେ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: A ମାଇନର୍ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେର C ଶାର୍ପ ମାଇନର୍ କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ…

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · lesson gtr-14-spotlight “Song spotlight: Spray Paint Sunrise” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ A ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 2 ରେ B, 3 ରେ C, 4 ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ।

Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 14 · challenge gtr-14-6 “Barre challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: E ଓ A ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ନିକଟତର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାଛିବା ଓ ସହଜ ବଦଳ। କର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 “Rhythm styles” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଫଙ୍କ୍‌ର ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ ସ୍କ୍ରାଚ୍, ରେଗେ ଚପ୍, କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍ ଓ ସିଙ୍କୋପେଟେଡ୍ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାର।

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଚାରି ଭାଗ କରେ: ଏକ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ, ଦୁଇ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ। ଝଙ୍କାର କରୁଥିବା ହାତର ବେଗ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ହୁଏ, ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ତଳ-ଉପର-ତଳ-ଉପର।

corrections.reason: Consistent unambiguous Western sixteenth-note duration terminology.

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତୋଟି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଥାଏ?

corrections.reason: Consistent unambiguous Western sixteenth-note duration terminology.

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଏକ-ଇ-ଓ-ଆ: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାର ଚାରିଟି ସମାନ ଭାଗ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-1 “Sixteenth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫଙ୍କ୍‌ରେ ନାଇନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ଖୁବ୍ ମାନେ। ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 6 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ସମତଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ହାତକୁ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ର ଲୟରେ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଝଙ୍କାର ସ୍ୱରହୀନ ଖସଖସିଆ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ହେବ। କେବଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଇବା ଆଘାତରେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

corrections.reason: Consistent unambiguous Western sixteenth-note duration terminology.

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଧରୁଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାର ଉପରେ ହାଲୁକା ରହିଲେ

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ନଚାପି ଛୁଇଁଲେ ତାର ଝଙ୍କାରିବା ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଝଙ୍କାର ଏକ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ତାଳବାଦ୍ୟ ପରି ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-2 “Funk: scratches and hits” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆଘାତରେ ଚାପି ତୁରନ୍ତ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ସ୍ୱର ଛୋଟ ରହିବ। ପୂରା E9 ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳକୁ ସରାଇଲେ D9 ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରେଗେ ଗିଟାର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଛୋଟ, ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ କର୍ଡରେ ଡ୍ରମ୍‌କୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଏ। କେବଳ ପତଳା ତାରରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡକୁ ତୁରନ୍ତ ରୋକନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କେବଳ ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ଚାରିଟି ତାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି A ମାଇନର୍ ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେର ଉପର ଅଂଶ: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3, ବାକି ତାରରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ବାରେ।

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ରେଗେ ଚପ୍ କେତେ ସମୟ ଝଙ୍କାରିବା ଦରକାର?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। ଚପ୍ ଏକ ଛୋଟ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଧ୍ୱନି; ତାହା ପରର ନୀରବତା ହିଁ ଲୟର ଅନୁଭବ ଦିଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-3 “Reggae: the offbeat chop” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏବେ D ବାରେର ଉପର ଅଂଶ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ସମତଳ, ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ଲୟ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ବାଣ୍ଟେ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବେସ୍ ସ୍ୱର, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥରେ ପତଳା ତାରର ଦ୍ରୁତ ଝଙ୍କାର। ବୁମ୍, ଚିକ୍, ବୁମ୍, ଚିକ୍।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ବୁମ୍-ଚିକ୍‌ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କ’ଣ ହୁଏ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବୁମ୍ ଅନ୍ୟ ତାରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: G ରେ ତାର 6, ତାପରେ ତାର 4। C ରେ ତାର 5, ତାପରେ 4। D ରେ ତାର 4, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା ତାର 5।

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-4 “Country boom-chick” · step 6 (along) · title
rows.translation: G, C ଓ D ରେ ବୁମ୍ ସ୍ୱର

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · title
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସିଙ୍କୋପେସନ୍‌ରେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ନଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଝଙ୍କାର ହୁଏ। ଏକରେ ତଳକୁ, ଦୁଇର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ, ତିନିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଉପରକୁ, ତାପରେ ଚାରିରେ ତଳ-ଉପର।

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚାରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ହାତ କ’ଣ କରେ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଦୋଳନ କେବେ ଥାମେ ନାହିଁ। ଦୁଇରେ ହାତ ତାର ନଛୁଇଁ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ, ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-5 “The syncopated pop strum” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପପ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଶେଷ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ, ଚାରିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତି, ଫଳରେ ନୂଆ କର୍ଡ ଅଳ୍ପ ଆଗରୁ ଆସେ। ଏହା ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · title

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫୁଲଝରିର ଋତୁ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: C ରେ ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମର ଉତ୍ସାହଭରା ଗୀତ, C, G, A ମାଇନର୍ ଓ F ଉପରେ। ସିଙ୍କୋପେଟେଡ୍ ପପ୍ ଝଙ୍କାରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଚାରିର ‘ଓ’ ରେ ଟିକେ ଆଗରୁ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 15 · lesson gtr-15-spotlight “Song spotlight: Sparkler Season” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା E ଓ ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D, ଦୁଇଥର, ତାପରେ ତାର 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G, ଓ ତଳକୁ ପୁଣି D।

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 16 · song gtr-16-3 “Oh! Susanna: the verse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଗୀତ ଦୁଇ ଅଂଶ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପାଳିକରି ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ପଦ କାହାଣୀ କହେ; ମୁଖଡ଼ା ଆକର୍ଷକ ଅଂଶକୁ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି କରେ। ଷ୍ଟିଫେନ୍ ଫଷ୍ଟର୍‌ଙ୍କ ଓଃ! ସୁଜାନା (1848) ରେ ଉଭୟ ଅଛି। କାପୋ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ: ଏହା G ରେ।

corrections.reason: Match fixed capo spelling in UI glossary and controls.

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.

rows.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଖୋଲା ବିନ୍ୟାସରୁ G ବଜାଇବାର ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ଥାନ ଓ ହାତ ପାଖରେ ରହୁଥିବା କର୍ଡ।

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ଖୋଲା C, A, G, E କିମ୍ବା D ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ସରାଇ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରେ। ଯେକୌଣସି ଗୋଟିକରୁ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ବିନ୍ୟାସଗୁଡ଼ିକ C A G E D କ୍ରମରେ ଆସନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଏ।

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C, A, G, E ଓ D: ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଖୋଲା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଯାହା ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ବେକର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରେ।

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-1 “One chord, five shapes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା G ରୁ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ E ବିନ୍ୟାସ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ G ବାରେ। ତାର 6 ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡର ସେହି G।

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା D କୁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ G। ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନଟ୍ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନ ପରି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ତାର 4 ଧରେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, 4 ଓ 3 ତାହା ଉପରେ D ତ୍ରିକୋଣ ପୁଣି ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା D ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଖୋଲା ତାର 4। ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାହା ଧରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର G। ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ମଧ୍ୟ G।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-2 “The D shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର E ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର D ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ଏକ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି: ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର G। ଦୁଇଟି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସରିବା ବେଳେ ତାହା ଉପରେ ନଜର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା C କୁ ସାତ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ G। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରହେ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 8 ଧରେ, ଏବଂ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ତାର 4 ଓ 5 ଯାଏଁ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି।

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା C ପରି C ବିନ୍ୟାସର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ରହେ…

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା C ର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3। ଏଠାରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ତାହା ଧରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 10 ର G।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-3 “The C shape” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: C ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 କୁ ତଳକୁ ସରାଇଲେ D, ଯାହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ। ନାମ ସବୁବେଳେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ହୁଏ।

rows.source: The A shape, and around again

Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 10 ରେ ତାର 5 ରୁ 1 ଯାଏଁ ବାରେ କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 12 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଏବଂ ପୁଣି G।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: A ବିନ୍ୟାସ ପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 12 ରେ G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫେରେ: ଖୋଲା G ଠାରୁ ଏକ ସପ୍ତକ ଉଚ୍ଚ। ସେଠାରୁ ପାଞ୍ଚ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ସମାନ କ୍ରମରେ ପୁଣି ଆସନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ବେକ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ A ପରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଆସେ?

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-4 “The A shape, and around again” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: କ୍ରମ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ହୁଏ: C, A, G, E, D, ତାପରେ ପୁଣି C। A ପରେ G ଆସେ।

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: CAGED ସହ ଦୂରକୁ ସରିବା କ୍ୱଚିତ୍ ଦରକାର। ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ G ହେଉଛି D ବିନ୍ୟାସ, C ହେଉଛି G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ D ହେଉଛି A ବିନ୍ୟାସ। ତିନି କର୍ଡ, ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ଥାନ।

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: D-ବିନ୍ୟାସ G ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ C ବଜାଏ?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C ର G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 8 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ଠିକ୍ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ହାତ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ।
