rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-5 “Chords near your hand” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସମାନ ଧାରଣା ତଳେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ E ବିନ୍ୟାସର G, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ A ବିନ୍ୟାସର C, ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ C ବିନ୍ୟାସର D।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · title
Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଲଣ୍ଠନର ପାହାଡ଼ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G, C ଓ D ରେ ନିଆଁ ଚାରିପାଖେ ମିଶି ଗାଇବା ଗୀତ। ମୁଖଡ଼ାକୁ ଖୋଲା କର୍ଡରେ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ, ତାପରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ପାଖରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ସେହି ଗୀତ ବେକର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯିବ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ କେଉଁ ବିନ୍ୟାସ C ବଜାଏ?

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C ର G ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଓ 8 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, D-ବିନ୍ୟାସ G ଓ A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ D ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · lesson gtr-17-spotlight “Song spotlight: Lantern Hill” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 17 · challenge gtr-17-6 “CAGED challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ସମସ୍ତ ପାଞ୍ଚ ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ G, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ପାଖରେ G, C ଓ D। ପ୍ରତି ବିନ୍ୟାସରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଲେ ତାହାର ନାମ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…

Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · title

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 “Triads up the neck” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ତାରରେ ତିନି-ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍, ପ୍ରତି ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍, ଓ ଅତି ଅଳ୍ପ ଚଳନର କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କର୍ଡ: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ତୃତୀୟ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ। ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ରେ ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ବେକର ଯେକୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ କାମ କରେ।

rows.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ C ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି?

Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର, ତୃତୀୟ, ପଞ୍ଚମ: C ରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼ି E, ତାପରେ ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି G।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-1 “Triads on the top strings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସବୁଠାରୁ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଉପରକୁ ନେଲେ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ହୁଏ। ତଳେ E ରଖିଲେ C ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 9, 8 ଓ 8 ରେ ଥାଏ। ତଳେ G ରଖିଲେ ତାହା ଖୋଲା C ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏହି ତାରରେ ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ତିନି ବିନ୍ୟାସରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ପ୍ରତି ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ପାଇଁ ଗୋଟିଏ। G ଓ D ରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଶିଖିଲେ ଯେକୌଣସି ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡ ପାଇପାରିବେ।

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 3 ଓ 3 ର G ର ବିନ୍ୟାସ କାହା ସହ ସମାନ…

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଉଭୟରେ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ସବୁଠାରୁ ତଳେ: ତାର 3 ରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରେ, ଅନ୍ୟ ଦୁଇଟି ସମାନ ସ୍ତରରେ। ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ପାଞ୍ଚ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ବ୍ୟବଧାନ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-2 “Inversions of G and D” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7, 7 ଓ 5 ର D ରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର C ପରି ମୂଳ-ସ୍ଥିତି ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଅଛି। ତଳେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 3 ଓ 2 ହେଉଛି ଖୋଲା D ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡର ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳକୁ ନେଲେ ମାଇନର୍ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ତାରରେ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 1 ଓ 0 ର A ମାଇନର୍ ହେଉଛି ଖୋଲା A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଉପର ଅଂଶ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ ବାରେ କଲେ ତଳେ C ସହ A ମାଇନର୍ ମିଳେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି, ତିନି ସ୍ୱର।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-3 “Minor triads” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 5 ଓ 3 ର E ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ତଳେ B ଥାଏ। ଏହା ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ମାଇନର୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପାଖରେ, ତେଣୁ ବଦଳ ଅତି ଛୋଟ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ହାତର ନିକଟତମ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍ ବାଛିଲେ କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମରେ ଚଳନ ଅତି ଅଳ୍ପ ହୁଏ। G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D ସବୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରୁ 5 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅଛନ୍ତି।

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4, 3, 3 ର G ରୁ 4, 5, 3 ର E ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ଗଲେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଅପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ରହେ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 3 ର B ଓ ତାର 1 ର G ସ୍ଥିର ରହନ୍ତି। କେବଳ ତାର 2 ର ସ୍ୱର D ରୁ E କୁ ଉଠେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-4 “Triads through a progression” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସେହି ଚାରି କର୍ଡ ଉପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛନ୍ତି: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 7, 8 ଓ 7 ରେ G, 9, 8 ଓ 7 ରେ E ମାଇନର୍, 9, 8 ଓ 8 ରେ C, ଏବଂ 7, 7 ଓ 5 ରେ D।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · title
Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ବଜାଇଲେ ଆର୍ପେଜିଓ ହୁଏ। କର୍ଡ କ୍ରମ ଭିତରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସୁର ଗଢ଼ନ୍ତି।

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-5 “Triad arpeggios” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏଠାରେ ଉପର ସ୍ୱର G, G, G, F ଶାର୍ପ: ତଳେ କର୍ଡ ବଦଳିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରାୟ ସ୍ଥିର। ଦୁଇ କର୍ଡରେ ଥିବା ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସାଧାରଣ ସ୍ୱର କୁହାଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ଏତେ ସୁଗମ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?

rows.translation: ଉପର ସ୍ୱର ଉଠିଲା ନା ତଳକୁ ଗଲା?

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରୋଲର୍ ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D ରେ ପୁରୁଣା ଶୈଳୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ ପପ୍, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରୁ 5 ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଚାରି ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ। ଉପର ସ୍ୱରର ତାରର ଛୋଟ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଗିଟାର ପରି ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଓ ସଂହତ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ରୋଲର୍ ସ୍କେଟିଂ ପଡ଼ିଆର କ୍ରମ G ର ପ୍ରଥମ, ଷଷ୍ଠ, ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚମ କର୍ଡ। ଷଷ୍ଠ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ?

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · lesson gtr-18-spotlight “Song spotlight: Roller Rink” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: G ମେଜର୍ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6। 6 ର କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍: E ମାଇନର୍।

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ମେଜର୍ ଓ ମାଇନର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ, ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଇନ୍‌ଭର୍ସନ୍, ଦୁଇ ସ୍ଥାନରେ G, E ମାଇନର୍, C ଓ D, ଏବଂ ଆର୍ପେଜିଓ। ପ୍ରତି ଚଳନ ଛୋଟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 18 · challenge gtr-18-6 “Triad challenge” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡ ହେଉଛି ମେଜର୍ ତ୍ରିସ୍ୱରୀ କର୍ଡରେ…

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 “Seventh chords and jazz voicings” · unit summary
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍, ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ, ଖୋଲା ଓ ବାରେ, ii–V–I, ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସଙ୍ଗତ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ। ଏହା ସାଧାରଣ ମେଜର୍ କର୍ଡକୁ କୋମଳ ଓ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନିଳ କରେ। ଖୋଲା Cmaj7 ହେଉଛି C ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଉଠାଇବା।

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: Cmaj7 ରେ C ସହ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: C ର ଠିକ୍ ତଳେ B।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-1 “Major seventh chords” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଛୋଟ F ବଜାନ୍ତୁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରେ କେବଳ ତାର 2 ଚାପନ୍ତୁ। ଖୋଲା ତାର 1, E, ହେଉଛି F ର ମେଜର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ। ଏହା ମୃଦୁ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳର ମଝିରେ। Am7 ହେଉଛି A ମାଇନର୍‌ରୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଉଠାଇବା।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: Dm7: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ଏବଂ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ସମତଳ। Em7: କେବଳ ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2।

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: Am7 ରେ A ମାଇନର୍ ସହ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଏ?

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-2 “Minor seventh chords” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ଉପର ସପ୍ତକଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ: A ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ G।

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · title
rows.translation: ତାର 5 ରେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ତାର 5 ଧରି ତାର 1 ଯାଏଁ ରହେ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3 ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ତାର 2 ଧରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: Dm7 ହେଉଛି A ମାଇନର୍ ବାରେରୁ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉଠାଇବା। D7 ହେଉଛି A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ, ଯେଉଁଠି ତାର 4 ଓ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ 4 ଥାଏ। ଉଭୟର ନାମ ତାର 5 ର ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆସେ।

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ Dm7। ଏହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର କେଉଁଠି?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-3 “Sevenths with the root on string 5” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି A-ବିନ୍ୟାସ କର୍ଡ ପରି ଏହାର ନାମ ତାର 5 ର ସ୍ୱରରୁ ଆସେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଜାଜ୍‌ର ପ୍ରିୟ ଗତି: ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ, ତାପରେ ପଞ୍ଚମ, ତାପରେ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରିବା। C ରେ Dm7, G7 ଓ Cmaj7।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ E7 ବିନ୍ୟାସ ବାରେ ଭାବେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ସମସ୍ତ ଛଅ ତାରରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1, ତାର 5 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ଓ ତାର 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 6 ରେ।

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

identity_decision.reason: Canonical Western chord symbol or note sequence; preserve exact symbols and sequence in this musical exercise.

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: C ପ୍ରଥମ, D ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ। D ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ା ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ D ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-4 “The ii–V–I” · step 7 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଜାଜ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ପ୍ରତି କର୍ଡକୁ କେବଳ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତେ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତି। ଝଙ୍କାର ବେଳେ ଚାପନ୍ତୁ, ତୁରନ୍ତ ପରେ ଢିଲା କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ କର୍ଡରେ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲୟ ଆସିବ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଗିଟାର ବାଦକ କମ୍ପିଂ କରନ୍ତି: ବ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଉତ୍ତର ଦେଉଥିବା ଛୋଟ କର୍ଡ। ଚାର୍ଲସ୍ଟନ୍ ଲୟ ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା ଓ ଦୁଇର ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ‘ଓ’ ରେ ବାଜେ, ତାପରେ ନୀରବ ସ୍ଥାନ ଛାଡ଼େ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-5 “Swing comping” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: G ରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ପଞ୍ଚମ, ପ୍ରଥମ ହେଉଛି Am7, D7 ଓ Gmaj7। Am7 ହେଉଛି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରେ E ମାଇନର୍ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ ବାରେ; Gmaj7 ତାର 5 ଛାଡ଼େ, ଏହାର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · title
Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · lesson gtr-19-spotlight “Song spotlight: Late Checkout” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ଚେକ୍‌ଆଉଟ୍ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: C ରେ ଲୋ-ଫାଇ, Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 ଓ Am7 ଉପରେ। ଏହା ii–V–I ସହ ପୁଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବାକୁ ଷଷ୍ଠ କର୍ଡ। ବାରେ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ ଓ ଚାର୍ଲସ୍ଟନ୍‌ରେ ସଙ୍ଗତ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.translation: C ମେଜର୍ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5। G ଉପରେ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ G7।

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 19 · challenge gtr-19-6 “Jazz chord challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: ମେଜର୍, ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ, ଖୋଲା ଓ ବାରେ, ଏବଂ C ଓ G ରେ ii–V–I। କର୍ଡ ଛୋଟ ଓ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 “The major scale in position” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଦୁଇ ସପ୍ତକର G ମେଜର୍, ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ଓ କର୍ଡ, ଏବଂ ଡୋରିଆନ୍ ଓ ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ମୋଡ୍।

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇଟି। ପ୍ରତି ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ କ୍ରମରେ ଉଠେ। ଏହି ଢାଞ୍ଚା ମେଜର୍‌କୁ ତାହାର ଧ୍ୱନି ଦିଏ।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଯାଏଁ ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ଠାରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ତାର 6, 5 ଓ 4 ଦେଇ ଉଠେ।

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 6: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ଓ 5, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ଓ 4। ତାର 5: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଓ 3, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଓ 2।

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5, ତାପରେ ତାର 4: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2, 4 ଓ 5। G ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କେଉଁଠି ଥାଏ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-1 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର 3 ରୁ 4। ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟି 7 ରୁ 8।

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସମାନ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଆଗେଇ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ: ତାର 3 ରେ A, B ଓ C, ତାର 2 ରେ D ଓ E, ତାର 1 ରେ F ଶାର୍ପ ଓ G। ହାତର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳେ ନାହିଁ।

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଏହି ସ୍ଥିତିରେ କେଉଁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ବଜାଏ?

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ତେଣୁ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର।

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-2 “Two octaves in position” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 1839 ରେ ଲୋୱେଲ୍ ମେସନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ସଜାଯାଇଥିବା ବିଶ୍ୱକୁ ଆନନ୍ଦ ଗୀତ ଉପରୁ ସିଧା ତଳକୁ G ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଆପଣ ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: G ଠାରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌କୁ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ: G ହେଉଛି 1, A ହେଉଛି 2, ଏଭଳି F ଶାର୍ପ, 7 ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞମାନେ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର ସୁର ଓ କର୍ଡ ବିଷୟରେ କହିବାକୁ ଏହି ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି।

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: G ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମରୁ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛାଡ଼ି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱର ଏକାଠି କଲେ ସେହି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡ ମିଳେ। 1, 4 ଓ 5 ର କର୍ଡ ମେଜର୍; 2, 3 ଓ 6 ର ମାଇନର୍। G ରେ: G, C ଓ D, ତାପରେ A ମାଇନର୍, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ E ମାଇନର୍।

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ରେ 6 ଉପରେ କେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ଗଢ଼େ?

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଷଷ୍ଠ ସ୍ୱର E, ଏବଂ 2, 3 ଓ 6 ର କର୍ଡ ମାଇନର୍। E, G ଓ B ଏକାଠି କଲେ E ମାଇନର୍।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-3 “Scale degrees and chords” · step 7 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: G ମେଜର୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର ବଜାଇ A କୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରିଲେ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ମାଇନର୍ ହୋଇଯାଏ। ଏହା A ଡୋରିଆନ୍, G ମେଜର୍‌ର ଏକ ମୋଡ୍: ସମାନ ସ୍ଥାନ, ନୂଆ ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱର।

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 6, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର A ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 4 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ସେହି ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଦେଇ ତାର 3 ର A ଯାଏଁ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର A ଡୋରିଆନ୍‌କୁ ସାଧାରଣ A ମାଇନର୍‌ଠାରୁ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ କରେ?

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ସାଧାରଣ A ମାଇନର୍‌ରେ F ଥାଏ। ଡୋରିଆନ୍ G ମେଜର୍‌ର F ଶାର୍ପ ରଖେ: ମାଇନର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ରେ ଏକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ସ୍ୱର।

rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 5 (along) · title
Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-4 “A Dorian” · step 6 (along) · title

Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏବେ D କୁ ମୂଳ ଭାବେ ଧରନ୍ତୁ। D ରୁ D ଯାଏଁ G ମେଜର୍‌ର ସ୍ୱର D ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍ ଗଢ଼େ: ମେଜର୍ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ସପ୍ତମ ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ତଳେ। ଏହା ଲୋକସଙ୍ଗୀତ, ରକ୍ ଓ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁରରେ ବହୁଳ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ।

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତାର 5, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ର D ଠାରୁ ସମାନ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର D ଯାଏଁ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-5 “D Mixolydian” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: D ମେଜର୍‌ରେ C ଶାର୍ପ ଥାଏ। D ମିକ୍ସୋଲିଡିଆନ୍‌ରେ ଥାଏ…

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · song gtr-22-5 “Down by the Riverside: your arrangement” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-spotlight “Song spotlight: Jukebox Moon” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଜୁକ୍‌ବକ୍ସର ଚାନ୍ଦ ଏକ Timbre ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ: AABA ଗଠନରେ ପଚାଶ ଦଶକର ଧୀର ନୃତ୍ୟ ଗୀତ, ଏକ ପଦ, ପୁଣି ସେହି ପଦ, F ରେ ସଂଯୋଗ ଅଂଶ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ପଦ। ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଝଙ୍କାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ନୂଆ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଲୟରେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଉପରମୁହାଁ ଝଙ୍କାର ସହ। ପୂରା ଗୀତଟି ଗୀତ ବିଭାଗର ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ଅଧୀନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.

rows.translation: ଚାରି ଗୀତ, କେତୋଟି କର୍ଡ ଓ ତିନି ଝଙ୍କାର ଢାଞ୍ଚା। ଛୋଟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ପରି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: ଗଣି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଚାଲୁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବେ ଶେଷ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · title

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 “New keys” · unit summary
rows.translation: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, D7, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G ମାଇନର୍, G, F ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ, ଏବଂ ଗୀତକୁ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନେବା।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ତାର 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ, ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ।

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେଉଁ କର୍ଡରେ ତାର 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ର ସ୍ଥାନ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ସହ ସମାନ?

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: F ରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଥାଏ। ବଦଳ ବେଳେ ସେଠାରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 4, 3 ଓ 2 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ଓ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2 ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: G ରେ G, C ଓ D7 କର୍ଡ ଅଧିକାଂଶ କାମ କରନ୍ତି, ଗମ୍ଭୀର ରଙ୍ଗ ପାଇଁ E ମାଇନର୍। G7 ଯେପରି C ଆଡ଼କୁ ଟାଣେ, D7 ସେପରି G କୁ ଫେରାଏ।

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
rows.translation: B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତାର 3, 2 ଓ 1 ଉପରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1 ରଖି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3 କୁ ତାର 4, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 4 ଯାଏଁ ପହଞ୍ଚାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: D ଓ B ମାଇନର୍ ଉଭୟ କେଉଁ ତାରର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଚାପନ୍ତି?

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଉଭୟ କର୍ଡ ତାର 3 ଓ 2 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ଧରନ୍ତି। କେବଳ ବାହାରର ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବଦଳନ୍ତି।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: D ରେ D, G ଓ A7 ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଅନ୍ତି, B ମାଇନର୍ ବିଷାଦର ରଙ୍ଗ ଯୋଡ଼େ। A7 ପାଇଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗୀତର କର୍ଡ ତାହାର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପଦକ୍ରମ: I, IV ଓ V। ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର ବଦଳିଲେ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ସମାନ ରହେ। C ରେ C, F ଓ G7; G ରେ G, C ଓ D7; F ରେ F, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଓ C7।

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: F ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: F, G, A, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱର B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଗୀତ ବହୁତ ଉଚ୍ଚ କିମ୍ବା ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ଅନ୍ୟ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ସମାନ ସଂଖ୍ୟା, ସମାନ ଗୀତ, କେବଳ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ଅଧିକ ମାନେ।

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: D ଠାରୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: D, E, F ଶାର୍ପ, G, A। A ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱର, ତେଣୁ A7 ହେଉଛି V କର୍ଡ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 2, ତାର 2, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 3, ଓ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି 1। ତାର 4 ଖୋଲା ଝଙ୍କାରେ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: D ମାଇନର୍‌ର ପରିବାର D ମାଇନର୍, G ମାଇନର୍ ଓ A7। E7 ଯେପରି A ମାଇନର୍‌କୁ ଟାଣେ, A7 ସେପରି D ମାଇନର୍ ମୂଳକୁ ଫେରାଏ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କୌଣସି ନୂଆ ଧାରଣା ନାହିଁ: B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, D7, B ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G ମାଇନର୍, ଏବଂ C, G, F ଓ D ରେ ବାଦନ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବିନ୍ୟାସ, ତାପରେ ସ୍ଥିର ଝଙ୍କାର।

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଚଙ୍କ୍, ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ସହ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାର, ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଓ ରାଗ୍‌ଟାଇମ୍ କର୍ଡ, 3-3-2 ରେ ଜୋର୍, ଏବଂ ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଚଙ୍କ୍ ହେଉଛି ତୁରନ୍ତ ଥାମିଯାଉଥିବା ଝଙ୍କାର। ତଳକୁ ଝଙ୍କାର କରି ସେହି ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ ପାପୁଲିର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱକୁ ତାର ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି ଛୋଟ, ଶୁଷ୍କ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 1 ରେ ତଳ, 2 ରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍, 3 ରେ ତଳ-ଉପର, 4 ରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍। ଡ୍ରମର୍ ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ବଜାଉଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍ ପଡ଼େ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଦୁଇ ଓ ଚାରି ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍, ଯେଉଁଠି ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ବାଜେ। ସେଠାରେ ଚଙ୍କ୍ ଝଙ୍କାରକୁ ଡ୍ରମର୍ ପରି ଶକ୍ତି ଦିଏ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାର D, DU, UDU ନେଇ 2 ର ତଳମୁହାଁକୁ ଚଙ୍କ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଲୟ ସମାନ ରହେ; ତାହାରେ ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍ ଆସେ।

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଏହି ଝଙ୍କାରରେ କେଉଁ ଚାଳନା ଚଙ୍କ୍ ହୁଏ?

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଝଙ୍କାରେ, ମାତ୍ରା 2 ରେ ଟିକ୍ ଧ୍ୱନି। ଅନ୍ୟ ସବୁ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଝଙ୍କାରର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ।

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱିଙ୍ଗ୍ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାକୁ ଅସମାନ ଭାବେ ବାଣ୍ଟେ: ଲମ୍ବା ତଳମୁହାଁ, ତାପରେ ଛୋଟ ଉପରମୁହାଁ। ଝଙ୍କାର ବେଳେ ହମ୍-ଟି, ଡମ୍-ଟି କୁହନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ପୁରୁଣା ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ ସୁରର ଦୋଳାୟମାନ ଲୟ।

corrections.reason: Match accepted UI and glossary spelling of this technique/instrument.

rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 1918 ରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ନଦୀ କୂଳରେ ଗୀତ ଏକାଠି ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ତିଆରି। ୟୁକୁଲେଲେରେ ଏହା G ରେ, G, C ଓ D7 ସହ, ଏବଂ ତାର 1, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ର ଗସ୍ପେଲ୍ ରଙ୍ଗର A ଶାର୍ପ।

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସେସିଲ୍ ଶାର୍ପ ଏହି ଇଂରାଜୀ ଧୀର ଗୀତ 1906 ରେ ଛାପିଥିଲେ। F ରେ ଏହା F, B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍, C ଓ C7, G ମାଇନର୍ ଓ D ମାଇନର୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ, ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଦୁଇଟି। ପଦ ମଝିରେ କର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ବଜାଇ ଝଙ୍କାରିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ବିସ୍ତୃତ ଜଳରାଶି: ଖୋଲା ତାର 3, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 1 ରେ F ଦୁଇଥର, ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ରେ G, ତାପରେ ଖୋଲା A।

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏଠାରେ ଅନେକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଅଧାରେ ବଦଳେ। ପଦକୁ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ଅଧା ଭାଗରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ କର୍ଡ, ଓ ପ୍ରତି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଟିକ୍‌ରେ ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.translation: କର୍ଡ ଛୁଟିଗଲା? ଝଙ୍କାର ଜାରି ରଖି ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀଟି ଧରନ୍ତୁ। ଗାଉଥିବା ଲୋକେ ତାଳ ଅନୁସରନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ନୁହେଁ।

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମଲି ମାଲୋନ୍ 1876 ରେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍: ମାତ୍ରା 1 ରେ ଜୋର୍ ଦେଇ ସୁରକୁ ଦୋଳିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। F ରେ ଏହା F, G ମାଇନର୍, C7, D ମାଇନର୍ ଓ G7 ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ: ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 2 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, 3 ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମା, 4 ରେ ଅନାମିକା, 5 ରେ କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ବେକ ପଛରେ, ମଧ୍ୟମାର ବିପରୀତରେ ରହେ।

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 3 ର G ରେ ମଧ୍ୟମାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ତିନି ତାର ଦେଇ ଉଠନ୍ତୁ: G A B C D E F ଶାର୍ପ G। ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରରୁ କାମ କରେ।

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ମଧ୍ୟମା, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି; ତାପରେ ତାର 3 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, ମଧ୍ୟମା।

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି; ତାପରେ ତାର 2 ରେ ତର୍ଜନୀ, ଅନାମିକା, କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି।

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?

rows.translation: ବିନ୍ୟାସକୁ ସରାଇ ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ। ଏବେ କେଉଁ ସ୍କେଲ୍?

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 3 · lesson bass-3-4 “The major scale shape” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତାର 4 ର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ 5 ହେଉଛି A, ତେଣୁ ସମାନ ବିନ୍ୟାସ A ମେଜର୍ ବଜାଏ।

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମୋଟାଉନ୍ ଯୁଗର ବେସ୍ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମରେ ବହୁ ଗତି ଥିଲା: କର୍ଡର ସ୍ୱର, ପର କର୍ଡକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର ଓ ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ ଆଘାତ। ସେହି ଭାବରେ ଏହି ନୂଆ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ ଲେଖାଯାଇଛି।

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ: C, E, G, ତାପରେ Aକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଥିବା B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍।

rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?

rows.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ 1ର ଶେଷରେ B ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ କ’ଣ କରେ?

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଏହା ପର କର୍ଡର ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱର Aଠାରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ ଉପରର ଯୋଡ଼ା ସ୍ୱର। ଏହା ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ପର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ନେଇଯାଏ।

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ଛନ୍ଦ ଓ ଚଳମାନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ରହନ୍ତୁ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପାଳି କରନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଗ୍ରୁଭ୍‌କୁ ଉପଭୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗ୍ରୁଭ୍‌ରେ କେଉଁ ଗଣନାରେ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜେ?

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.context: Violin course · course subtitle
rows.translation: ଖୋଲା ତାରରୁ ଫିଡଲ୍ ସୁର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ବୋ ଚଳାଇ ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖି ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · title

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 “Hello, violin” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଧରନ୍ତୁ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଖୋଲା ତାର ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଗୀତ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍ ଥୋଡ଼ି ତଳେ ରଖିଲେ ବାମରୁ ଡାହାଣକୁ ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ G, D, A, E। G ସବୁଠୁ ମୋଟା ଓ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର। E ସବୁଠୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର; ଏହାକୁ ତାର 1 କୁହାଯାଏ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତାରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଉଠାଇ ରଖୁଥିବା ପତଳା କାଠର ଖିଲାଣ ହେଉଛି ବ୍ରିଜ୍। କେବଳ ତାରର ଚାପରେ ଏହା ଠିଆ ରହେ। ଢଳିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ବା ଯନ୍ତ୍ର ଦୋକାନର ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ସିଧା କରାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: E ସବୁଠୁ ପତଳା ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ତାର। E (1)ରୁ G (4) ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତାର ଗଣାଯାଏ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବୋ ବ୍ୟବହାର ପୂର୍ବରୁ ତାର ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ଡାହାଣ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ରଖି ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ତାର ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହାକୁ ପିଜିକାଟୋ କୁହାଯାଏ।

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଛୋଟ ଗିଟାର୍ ପରି ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌କୁ କୋଳରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାର 2, Aକୁ ଟାଣି ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-1 “Meet your violin” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌ର ତଳ ଧାରକୁ ବାମ କଲାରବୋନ୍‌ରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଇ ଚିନ୍ ରେଷ୍ଟରେ ହନୁ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ମୁଣ୍ଡର ଓଜନ ଯନ୍ତ୍ରକୁ ଧରି ରଖେ। ଚାପି ଧରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍କ୍ରୋଲ୍‌କୁ ଆଗକୁ ଓ ବାମକୁ, ପ୍ରାୟ ଚଟାଣ ସହ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ବାମ ହାତରେ ନେକ୍‌କୁ ଧରନ୍ତୁ; ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ସାମ୍ନାରେ ରହିବ। ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ସିଧା ଓ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଚିନ୍ ରେଷ୍ଟରେ ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ହାତ ଚାପି ଧରିଲେ ବା କାନ୍ଧ ଉଠାଇଲେ ଟାଣ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ବେସୁରା କରେ।

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଧରି D ତାର, ତାର 3କୁ ଟାଣି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-2 “Hold the violin” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କାଠର ଦଣ୍ଡ ଆପଣ ଧରୁଥିବା ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରୁ ଅଗ୍ରଭାଗ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ରହେ। ମଝିରେ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଲୋମ ଟଣା ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଲୋମ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ପେନସିଲ୍ ପଶିବା ଯାଏଁ ପେଚ କଷନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିକୁ ବଙ୍କା କରି ଫ୍ରଗ୍ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡର ସଂଯୋଗ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ତା’ର ଅଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଅନ୍ୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଦଣ୍ଡ ଉପରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ; କାଣି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଉପରେ ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇ ଠିଆ ରହିବ। ପୂରା ହାତ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
rows.translation: ବଙ୍କା ହୋଇ, ଫ୍ରଗ୍ ଓ ଦଣ୍ଡର ସଂଯୋଗରେ

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରେ ବଙ୍କା ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ରଖିଲେ ହାତ ଢିଲା ରହେ ଓ ବୋର ସନ୍ତୁଳନ ରକ୍ଷା ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରୋଜିନ୍ ବିନା ଲୋମ ତାର ଉପରେ ଖସିଯାଏ, ଶବ୍ଦ ହୁଏନି। ବଜାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଲୋମରେ ରୋଜିନ୍ ଖଣ୍ଡ କିଛିଥର ଘଷନ୍ତୁ। ହାଲୁକା ପ୍ରଲେପ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ।

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ମଝିରେ A ତାର ଉପରେ ବୋ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଧୀରେ ଡାହାଣକୁ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ D ତାର। କହୁଣି ଟିକେ ଉଠାଇ ଧୀରେ ଟାଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-3 “Hold the bow” · step 7 (along) · title

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନରୁ ଉଚ୍ଚ: G, D, A, E। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ପୂର୍ବ ତାରଠାରୁ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉପରେ; ଏହାକୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହାଯାଏ। ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ: Good Dogs Always Eat।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଡାହାଣ କହୁଣି ବୋ କେଉଁ ତାରରେ ବାଜିବ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେ। G ପାଇଁ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ, E ପାଇଁ ତଳକୁ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଶିଡ଼ିର ପାହାଚ ପରି ପ୍ରତି ତାରର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ଅଛି।

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: G ତାରରେ ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ Dରେ। G ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ରହେ।

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ A, ପରେ E। ପ୍ରତିଟି ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ତର ତଳକୁ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେଉଁ ତାର ପାଇଁ କହୁଣି ସବୁଠୁ ଉଚ୍ଚରେ ରହେ?

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-4 “The open strings” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: G ତାର ସବୁଠୁ ବାମରେ ଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ସେଠାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବାକୁ ବାହୁ ଉଠେ। E ପାଇଁ ବାହୁ ସବୁଠୁ ତଳେ ରହେ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅର୍କେଷ୍ଟ୍ରା A ସହ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତି ତାର ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ କେତେ ସେଣ୍ଟ ଦୂରରେ ଅଛି Timbre ଦେଖାଏ; 100 ସେଣ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପିଆନୋର ସବୁଠୁ ଛୋଟ ଅନ୍ତର। A, ପରେ D, G ଓ Eର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଟେଲ୍‌ପିସ୍‌ର ଛୋଟ ପେଚଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଫାଇନ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର୍। ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ଘଣ୍ଟାକଣ୍ଟା ଦିଗରେ, ନିମ୍ନ କରିବାକୁ ବିପରୀତ ଦିଗରେ ବୁଲାନ୍ତୁ। ଚଉଠେ ଘେରା ବୁଲାଇବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ।

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ତାରର ସ୍ୱର ଟିକେ ନିମ୍ନ ଅଛି। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଫ୍ଲାଟ୍ ଅର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱର ଅତି ନିମ୍ନ। ଘଣ୍ଟାକଣ୍ଟା ଦିଗରେ ବୁଲାଇଲେ ତାର କଷି ହୁଏ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଫାଇନ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର୍ ଆଉ ବୁଲି ନପାରିଲେ ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଭିତରକୁ ଚାପି ଟିକେ ବୁଲାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଏହା ଅଟକି ରହିବ। ତାର ବହୁତ ବେସୁରା ଥିଲେ ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କୁ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ; ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ଖସିପାରେ।

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: A ତାରର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · lesson vln-1-5 “Tune your violin” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ D, G ଓ E। ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ମିଳାଇ, ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କଲାରବୋନ୍‌ରେ ଭାୟୋଲିନ୍, ବୋ ଢିଲା ଧରି, ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡ ମଝିରେ ବୋ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏବେ ଏହି ଏକକର ସବୁକିଛି ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚରୁ ନିମ୍ନକୁ ପ୍ରତି ଖୋଲା ତାରରେ ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଅର୍କେଷ୍ଟ୍ରା A ସହ ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ ସେଠାରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ପରେ ଅନ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସୁର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · challenge vln-1-6 “Open-string checkup” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: “ମେରୀର ଛୋଟ ମେଣ୍ଢା” A ତାରରେ ବାଜେ: ଖୋଲା A, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ B, ଆଉ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ C ଶାର୍ପ। ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟାଣି, ପରେ ବୋରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

corrections.reason: Match canonical translated song title.

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: A ତାରରେ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା B।

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଠାରୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି। ଏହା C ଶାର୍ପ।

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 1 · song vln-1-7 “Mary Had a Little Lamb” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: C ଶାର୍ପ, B, A, B, ପରେ ତିନିଥର C ଶାର୍ପ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · title

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 “Bowing” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଲମ୍ବା, ସମାନ ବୋ ଚାଳନା, ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ତାର ବଦଳ ଓ ପ୍ରଥମ ଛନ୍ଦ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋରେ ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରୁ ଅଗ୍ରଭାଗ ଆଡ଼କୁ ବୋ ଡାହାଣକୁ ଟଣା ହୁଏ। ଅପ୍-ବୋରେ ତାହା ବାମକୁ ଫେରେ। ସ୍ୱରଲିପିରେ ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋ ଚିହ୍ନ ଛୋଟ ଟେବୁଲ୍ ପରି ଓ ଅପ୍-ବୋ ଚିହ୍ନ V ପରି।

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 2 (quiz) · quiz answer

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ଓ ଫିଙ୍ଗରବୋର୍ଡର ଶେଷ ମଝିରେ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ରେଳପଥରେ ଟ୍ରେନ୍ ପରି ବୋକୁ ବ୍ରିଜ୍ ସହ ସମାନ୍ତରାଳ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

corrections.reason: Use an unambiguous natural term for railway track in the bow analogy.

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: Aରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଡାଉନ୍-ବୋ, ପରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଧୀର ଅପ୍-ବୋ। ଶେଷ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଶବ୍ଦ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-1 “Down-bow, up-bow” · step 6 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। ଦ୍ରୁତ ସ୍ୱର ପାଇଁ କମ୍ ବୋ ଦରକାର, ତେଣୁ ବୋର ମଝି ଅଧା ଭାଗ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ପ୍ରତି ଚାଳନାର ଦୈର୍ଘ୍ୟ ସମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 3 (along) · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। ଲମ୍ବା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚଳାନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଶବ୍ଦ କମି ନଯିବ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେଉଁ ନୋଟ୍ ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ବୋ ଦରକାର?

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-2 “Quarter notes, half notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ସମୟ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଲମ୍ବା, ଧୀର ବୋ ଚାଳନା ଦରକାର।

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତାର ବଦଳାଇବାକୁ ମଣିବନ୍ଧ ନୁହେଁ, କହୁଣିର ଉଚ୍ଚତା ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ। ବୋର ଦିଗ ବଦଳିବା ଠିକ୍ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ନୂଆ ଉଚ୍ଚତାରେ ପହଞ୍ଚନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: A, E, A, E। କହୁଣିକୁ ଦୁଇ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଦୋଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-3 “String crossings” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: Gରୁ Aକୁ ଯିବାବେଳେ D ତାର ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ହୁଏ, ତେଣୁ କହୁଣି ଅଧିକ ଚଳେ। ସହଜରେ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ ଓ ମଝି ତାରକୁ ବାଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି ବାଜେ। ବୋର ମଝି ପାଖରେ ଛୋଟ, ଦ୍ରୁତ ଚାଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ କେତେଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ବାଜେ?

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · lesson vln-2-4 “Eighth notes” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏବେ ମିଶାନ୍ତୁ: ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍, ଦୁଇଟି ଏଇଥ୍, ପରେ ଦୁଇଟି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଫିଡଲ୍ ବାଦକମାନେ ଏହି ଛନ୍ଦ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରଥମେ କୁହନ୍ତୁ: ଲମ୍ବା, ଛୋଟ-ଛୋଟ, ଲମ୍ବା, ଲମ୍ବା।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · title
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ପର୍ଶ ବିନ୍ଦୁରେ ସିଧା ବୋ, କହୁଣିରୁ ତାର ବଦଳ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଛନ୍ଦ। ଏଠାରେ ତିନୋଟିକୁ ମିଶାଇବା।

rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.context: Violin · Unit 2 · challenge vln-2-5 “Bowing checkup” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
