Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum is a single note, dit is a brush and ty is the thumb on the fifth string.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-2 “Bum-ditty” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବମ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ସ୍ୱର, ଡିଟ୍ ହେଉଛି ଝଙ୍କାର ଏବଂ ଟି ହେଉଛି ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ।

rows.source: In clawhammer the melody notes fall on the bum strikes. The brush and thumb fill in around them, so tune and rhythm come out together.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ରେ ସୁରର ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବମ୍ ଆଘାତରେ ପଡ଼େ। ଝଙ୍କାର ଓ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ ମଝିର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ପୂରଣ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ସୁର ଓ ଛନ୍ଦ ଏକାଠି ଶୁଭେ।

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Where do the melody notes go in bum-ditty?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The bum lands on the beat, so that is where the melody goes. Dit and ty keep the rhythm rolling.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · lesson bjo-6-3 “Melody in the bum” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବମ୍ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ପଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ସୁର ସେଠାରେ ବାଜେ। ଡିଟ୍ ଓ ଟି ଛନ୍ଦକୁ ଚଳାଇ ରଖନ୍ତି।

rows.source: Skip to My Lou was a party game in the 1840s. In clawhammer each melody note is a bum, followed by a brush and the thumb on string 5.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍କିପ୍ ଟୁ ମାଇ ଲୁ 1840 ଦଶକରେ ଏକ ଆସରର ଖେଳ ଥିଲା। କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ରେ ସୁରର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ଏକ ବମ୍, ତାପରେ ଝଙ୍କାର ଓ ତାର 5 ରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ ଆସେ।

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: What does your thumb play after each brush?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଝଙ୍କାର ପରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି କ’ଣ ବଜାଏ?

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bum, dit, ty: the ty is always the thumb on the short fifth string.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବମ୍, ଡିଟ୍, ଟି: ଟି ସବୁବେଳେ ଛୋଟ ପଞ୍ଚମ ତାରରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ବାଦନ।

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · song bjo-6-4 “Skip to My Lou” · step 5 (along) · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · title
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Everything in clawhammer comes back to bum-ditty. Keep the motion loose and the thumb ready, and the melody takes care of itself.
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କ୍ଲହାମର୍‌ର ସବୁକିଛି ବମ୍-ଡିଟିକୁ ଫେରେ। ହାତର ଗତି ଢିଲା ଓ ବୁଢ଼ା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସୁର ନିଜେ ଗଢ଼ିଉଠିବ।

rows.source: Which hand shape does clawhammer use?
rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
rows.translation: ପିକ୍ ପିନ୍ଧି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିରେ ଉପରକୁ ଟାଣି ବଜାଇବା

rows.context: Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Banjo · Unit 6 · challenge bjo-6-5 “Clawhammer challenge” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
rows.translation: ଢିଲା ପଞ୍ଝା ପରି, ତଳମୁଖୀ ଆଘାତ କରି

rows.context: Ear Training course · title

rows.source: Hear intervals and chords, and sing back what you hear
rows.context: Ear Training course · course subtitle
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ କର୍ଡ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · title

rows.source: Tell which of two notes is higher, from wide leaps down to the smallest step.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 “Higher or lower” · unit summary
rows.translation: ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରଠାରୁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ, ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚିହ୍ନନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · title

rows.source: Pitch is how high or low a note sounds. On a keyboard, low notes sit on the left and high notes on the right. Your ear already knows the difference; here you sharpen it.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱର କେତେ ଉଚ୍ଚ କିମ୍ବା ନିମ୍ନ ଶୁଭେ, ତାହା ହେଉଛି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା। କୀବୋର୍ଡରେ ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱର ବାମ ପଟେ ଓ ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଡାହାଣ ପଟେ ଥାଏ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାନ ଏହି ତଫାତ ଜାଣିସାରିଛି; ଏଠାରେ ତାହାକୁ ଆହୁରି ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ କରିବେ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: When the second note is higher, the melody moves up. When it's lower, it moves down. Trace the direction in the air with your hand as you listen.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ସୁର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଏହା ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ସୁର ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ। ଶୁଣିବା ବେଳେ ହାତରେ ସେହି ଦିଗକୁ ପବନରେ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Does the second note go up or down?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-1 “High and low” · step 6 (listen) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଏ କି ତଳକୁ?

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The closer two notes are, the harder they are to tell apart. Let each note finish before you answer. Every answer, right or wrong, trains your ear.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ଯେତେ ନିକଟ, ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅଲଗା ଚିହ୍ନିବା ସେତେ କଠିନ। ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ଶେଷ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଠିକ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଭୁଲ୍, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଉତ୍ତର ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାନକୁ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରାଏ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Not sure? Hum the first note, then slide your voice to the second. Feel whether your voice climbs or sinks. Your body knows the direction.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-2 “Smaller leaps” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହନ୍ତି? ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ସରାଇ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ନିଜ ସ୍ୱର ଉଠୁଛି କି ଓହ୍ଲାଉଛି ଅନୁଭବ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଶରୀର ଦିଗଟି ଜାଣେ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · title

rows.source: Many melodies move to the very next note of the scale: a small step. Steps sound smooth and close. Listen for a gentle lift or dip instead of a jump.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅନେକ ସୁର ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଯାଏ: ଏକ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଏହି ଗତି ମସୃଣ ଓ ନିକଟ ଶୁଭେ। ଡେଇଁବା ବଦଳରେ ହାଲୁକା ଉଠିବା କିମ୍ବା ଓହ୍ଲାଇବା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold the first note in your head while the second one plays. Then compare them, like checking two heights side by side.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-3 “Next-door notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱର ବାଜୁଥିବା ବେଳେ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ମନରେ ଧରି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ତାପରେ ଦୁଇଟି ଉଚ୍ଚତାକୁ ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖି ଦେଖିବା ପରି ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The smallest step in most music is the half step, also called a semitone: from one key on a keyboard to the very next. It's a tiny move, and you can learn to hear it.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଯାହାକୁ ସେମିଟୋନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ: କୀବୋର୍ଡର ଏକ କୀରୁ ଠିକ୍ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କୀ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ଏହା ଏକ ଅତି ଛୋଟ ଗତି, ଏବଂ ଆପଣ ଏହାକୁ ଶୁଣି ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଶିଖିପାରିବେ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: With tiny steps, your first impression is usually right. Answer, and don't talk yourself out of it.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · lesson ear-1-4 “The smallest step” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅତି ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଅନୁଭବ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଠିକ୍ ଥାଏ। ଉତ୍ତର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ନିଜ ଉତ୍ତରକୁ ନିଜେ ସନ୍ଦେହ କରି ବଦଳାନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Wide leaps, small steps and half steps, high and low, all mixed together. Take a breath before each one.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 1 · challenge ear-1-5 “Higher or lower challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ଡିଆଁ, ଛୋଟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଉଚ୍ଚ ଓ ନିମ୍ନ, ସବୁ ମିଶିଛି। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକଟି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଥରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

corrections.reason: Use established Odia ଡିଆଁ for melodic skip/leap rather than Hindi-style loan, consistent with adjacent reviewed5400–5499 instruction.

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · title

rows.source: Hear when two notes match, then match a note with your voice or instrument.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 “Same or different” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର କେବେ ସମାନ ହୁଏ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ନିଜ କଣ୍ଠ କିମ୍ବା ବାଦ୍ୟରେ ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · title

rows.source: Two notes match when they have exactly the same pitch. Listen for whether the second note lands right on the first or slips away from it.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱରର ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ଠିକ୍ ସମାନ ହେଲେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଳନ୍ତି। ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରଟି ଠିକ୍ ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ୱର ସହ ମିଳୁଛି, ନା ତାହାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ହେଉଛି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Two voices sing exactly the same pitch. What's that called?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଦୁଇଟି କଣ୍ଠ ଠିକ୍ ସମାନ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତି। ତାହାକୁ କ’ଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Singing in unison means singing the very same note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-1 “Same or different?” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରେ ଗାଇବା ଅର୍ଥ ଠିକ୍ ସେହି ଏକ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଗାଇବା।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To match a pitch, listen, hear the note again in your head, then sing or play it. Timbre shows whether you're high or low. Slide until you land on it.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ମିଳାଇବାକୁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ସ୍ୱରଟିକୁ ମନରେ ପୁଣି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଉଚ୍ଚ କି ନିମ୍ନ, Timbre ଦେଖାଏ। ଠିକ୍ ମିଳିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing or play back the note you just heard.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing or play back the second note you heard.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If you're off, don't stop. Slide slowly up or down until the note locks in. That slide is how your ear and voice learn to agree.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-2 “Match a note” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସୁର ଭୁଲ୍ ହେଲେ ଅଟକନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। ଠିକ୍ ସୁର ମିଳିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧୀରେ ଉପରକୁ କିମ୍ବା ତଳକୁ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହି ସରାଇବା ଦ୍ୱାରା କାନ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ଏକମତ ହେବା ଶିଖନ୍ତି।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before you sing, replay the note silently in your head. Musicians call this audiation: hearing music that isn't sounding. It's the heart of a good ear.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସ୍ୱରଟିକୁ ମନେମନେ ପୁଣି ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞମାନେ ଏହାକୁ ଅଡିଏସନ୍ କୁହନ୍ତି: ବାସ୍ତବରେ ବାଜୁ ନ ଥିବା ସଙ୍ଗୀତକୁ ମନରେ ଶୁଣିବା। ଭଲ ଶ୍ରବଣ ଦକ୍ଷତାର ଏହା ମୂଳ।

rows.source: Sing or play back the higher note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing or play back the lower note.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-3 “Hold it in your head” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରକୁ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now match two notes in a row. Sing the first, then move to the second. Notice whether your voice climbs or drops to get there.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏବେ କ୍ରମରେ ଦୁଇଟି ସ୍ୱର ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରଥମଟି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟଟିକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସେଠାକୁ ଯିବା ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଉଠୁଛି କି ଓହ୍ଲାଉଛି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing or play back the notes you just heard, in order.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · lesson ear-2-4 “Two notes back” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସ୍ୱରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସେହି କ୍ରମରେ ପୁଣି ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ କିମ୍ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · title
Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same or different, single notes and pairs. Listen all the way through before you sing, and slide until each note settles.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 2 · challenge ear-2-5 “Pitch match challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସମାନ କି ଭିନ୍ନ, ଏକକ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ା। ଗାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପୂରା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱର ସରାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Hear half steps and whole steps, then the wider skip of a third.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 “Steps and skips” · unit summary
rows.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ଓ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

corrections.reason: Use established Odia ଡିଆଁ for melodic skip/leap rather than Hindi-style loan, consistent with adjacent reviewed5400–5499 instruction.

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A half step moves to the very next key. A whole step skips one key, so it equals two half steps. Both sound like steps, but a whole step opens a little wider.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଠିକ୍ ପର ଚାବିକୁ ଯାଏ। ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମଝିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର। ଦୁହିଁଟି କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ପରି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଟିକେ ବଡ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: How many half steps make a whole step?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେତେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମିଶି ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ହୁଏ?

rows.source: A whole step skips one key, so it's two half steps.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-1 “Half steps and whole steps” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଗୋଟିଏ ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Musicians call a step a second, because it moves to the next letter: C to D. A half step is a minor second. A whole step is a major second.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞ କ୍ରମିକ ସ୍ୱର ଗତିକୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହନ୍ତି, କାରଣ ଏହା Cରୁ D ପରି ପର ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ; ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: E and F have no key between them: a half step, so a minor second.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: E ଓ F ମଝିରେ ଚାବି ନାହିଁ: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

rows.source: C up to D is a...
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C to D skips the black key between them: a whole step, so a major second.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-2 “Seconds” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: Cରୁ D ମଝିର କଳା ଚାବି ଛାଡ଼େ: ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

rows.source: A step moves to the next letter. A skip jumps over one, like C to E, skipping D. That gap is called a third. Skips sound more open than steps.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ପର ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ। ଡିଆଁ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଷର ଛାଡ଼େ, ଯେପରି D ଛାଡ଼ି Cରୁ E। ସେହି ଅନ୍ତରକୁ ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର କୁହାଯାଏ। ଡିଆଁ କ୍ରମିକ ଗତିଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଖୋଲା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.source: D to F jumps over E, so it's a skip: a third.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-3 “Steps and skips” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: Dରୁ Fରେ E ଛାଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଏହା ଡିଆଁ: ତୃତୀୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · title
Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A major third spans four half steps and sounds bright. A minor third spans three and sounds darker, a little wistful. Listen for the brightness.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଚାରି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ତିନି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଓ ଟିକେ ବିଷାଦମୟ। ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳତା ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 2 (listen) · quiz answer

rows.source: C up to E spans how many half steps?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: Cରୁ E ଉପରକୁ କେତେ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର?

rows.source: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: four half steps, so it's a major third.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · lesson ear-3-4 “Major and minor thirds” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: C, C♯, D, D♯, E: ଚାରି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ତେଣୁ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ।

Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Half steps, whole steps and thirds, rising and falling. Decide step or skip first, then the exact size.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 3 · challenge ear-3-5 “Steps and skips challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଓ ତୃତୀୟ, ଉପର ଓ ତଳକୁ। ପ୍ରଥମେ କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି ନା ଡିଆଁ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ଠିକ୍ ଆକାର।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · title

rows.source: Unison, octave, fifth and fourth, each linked to a tune you can hum.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 “Intervals I” · unit summary
rows.translation: ୟୁନିସନ୍, ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍, ପଞ୍ଚମ ଓ ଚତୁର୍ଥ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣେଇ ପାରୁଥିବା ସୁର ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ା।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · title
Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval is the distance between two notes. A unison is no distance at all: the same note twice. An octave runs from one letter to the same letter above, like C to C. It sounds like one note, only brighter.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରର ଦୂରତା। ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରେ ଦୂରତା ନାହିଁ: ସମାନ ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇଥର। ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଷରରୁ ଉପରର ସମାନ ଅକ୍ଷରକୁ ଯାଏ, Cରୁ C ପରି। ଏହା ଏକ ସ୍ୱର ପରି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅଧିକ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Jingle Bells opens on one note repeated: a unison. Take Me Out to the Ball Game opens with a leap up an octave. Hum each opening to recall the sound.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଜିଙ୍ଗଲ ବେଲ୍ସ ଏକ ସ୍ୱରର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି, ୟୁନିସନ୍‌ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଟେକ୍ ମି ଆଉଟ୍ ଟୁ ଦ ବଲ୍ ଗେମ୍ ଏକ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଧ୍ୱନି ମନେ ପକାଇବାକୁ ପ୍ରତି ଆରମ୍ଭ ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-1 “Unison and octave” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fifth spans seven half steps, like C up to G. It sounds open and strong. Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star leaps up a fifth after its first two notes.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପରଫେକ୍ଟ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସାତ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Cରୁ G ଉପରକୁ ପରି। ଖୋଲା ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ମିଟିମିଟି ଛୋଟ ତାରା ପ୍ରଥମ ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ପରେ ପଞ୍ଚମ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ।

rows.source: What's a perfect fifth above D?
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count five letters: D, E, F, G, A. D to A spans seven half steps.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-2 “The perfect fifth” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷର ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: D, E, F, G, A। Dରୁ A ସାତ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର।

rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · title

rows.source: A perfect fourth spans five half steps, like C up to F. It sounds like a call to attention. Amazing Grace opens with a rising fourth.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପରଫେକ୍ଟ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ପାଞ୍ଚ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Cରୁ F ଉପରକୁ ପରି। ଧ୍ୟାନ ଆକର୍ଷଣର ଡାକ ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଅଦ୍ଭୁତ ଅନୁଗ୍ରହ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ।

rows.source: Both sound open. The fifth is wider and feels settled. The fourth feels like it wants to move on. If you're unsure, hum the tune for each.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-3 “The perfect fourth” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦୁହିଁଟି ଖୋଲା ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ପଞ୍ଚମ ବଡ଼ ଓ ସ୍ଥିର ଲାଗେ। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଆଗକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁବା ପରି ଲାଗେ। ସନ୍ଦେହ ଥିଲେ ପ୍ରତିଟିର ସୁର ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: An interval keeps its name whether it rises or falls. G down to C is still a fifth. Listen to the size of the gap, not the direction.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଉପର ବା ତଳକୁ ଗଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରର ନାମ ସମାନ। Gରୁ C ତଳକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ପଞ୍ଚମ। ଦିଗ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୂରତାର ଆକାର ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: When two notes sound together, listen to the blend. An octave melts into one sound. A fifth sounds hollow and strong. A fourth sounds open but restless.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର ଏକାଠି ବାଜିଲେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଶୁଣନ୍ତୁ। ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ଏକ ଶବ୍ଦରେ ମିଶେ। ପଞ୍ଚମ ଫମ୍ପା ଓ ଦୃଢ଼ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଚତୁର୍ଥ ଖୋଲା, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅସ୍ଥିର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.source: Sing or play a falling fifth: G down to C.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 4 · lesson ear-4-4 “Falling and together” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତଳକୁ ପଞ୍ଚମ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ ବା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ: Gରୁ C।

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In opens with a major third, bright and bold. Greensleeves opens with a minor third, softer and sadder. Hum both to fix the sounds.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସନ୍ଥମାନେ ଆଗେଇ ଆସିଲେ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ଦୃଢ଼ ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ସବୁଜ ଆସ୍ତିନ ନରମ, ବିଷାଦମୟ ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଧ୍ୱନି ମନେ ରଖିବାକୁ ଦୁଇଟି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A minor third spans three half steps, like A to C. A major third spans four.
rows.context: Ear Training · Unit 5 · lesson ear-5-1 “Thirds you know” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମାଇନର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ତିନି ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର, Aରୁ C ପରି। ମେଜର୍ ତୃତୀୟ ଚାରି।

rows.source: A major sixth spans nine half steps; My Bonnie Lies Over the Ocean opens with one. A minor sixth spans eight and sounds darker. The Entertainer leaps up one right after its quick opening notes.

rows.translation: ମେଜର୍ ଷଷ୍ଠ ନଅ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର; ମାଇ ବନି ଲାଇଜ୍ ଓଭର୍ ଦ ଓସନ୍ ଏଥିରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ମାଇନର୍ ଷଷ୍ଠ ଆଠ ଓ ଅଧିକ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଦ ଏଣ୍ଟର୍‌ଟେନର୍ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଆରମ୍ଭ ସ୍ୱର ପରେ ଏହି ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ଉପରକୁ ଡିଆଁ ମାରେ।

rows.source: Frère Jacques opens with a major second, a whole step up. Für Elise opens by rocking down and up a minor second, a half step. Small sizes, big difference.

rows.translation: ଫ୍ରେର୍ ଜାକ୍ ମେଜର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତର ଉପରକୁ ଯାଇ ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଫ୍ୟୁର୍ ଏଲିଜେ ମାଇନର୍ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ, ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧ ସ୍ୱରାନ୍ତରରେ ତଳ-ଉପର ଦୋଳି ଆରମ୍ଭ। ଛୋଟ ଆକାର, ବଡ଼ ତଫାତ।

rows.source: First judge the size: a step, a skip or a wide leap. Then judge the color: bright for major, darker for minor. Two easy choices beat one hard guess.

rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଆକାର ବିଚାର କରନ୍ତୁ: କ୍ରମିକ ଗତି, ଛୋଟ ଡିଆଁ ବା ବଡ଼ ଡିଆଁ। ପରେ ରଙ୍ଗ: ମେଜର୍ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ମାଇନର୍ ଗମ୍ଭୀର। ଏକ କଠିନ ଅନୁମାନଠାରୁ ଦୁଇ ସହଜ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଭଲ।

rows.source: A chord is three or more notes sounding together. A major chord sounds bright and settled. A minor chord sounds darker. Only the middle note differs between them.

rows.source: A dominant seventh chord is a major chord plus one more note on top: a minor seventh above the root, the note the chord is named for. It sounds bluesy and restless.

rows.translation: ସମାନ ଅକ୍ଷରର ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସଦୃଶ ଶୁଣାଯାନ୍ତି। ଗୋଟିଏ Cରୁ ପର Cର ଦୂରତା ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍। ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱର ଠିକ୍ ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ବେଗରେ କମ୍ପେ।

rows.source: Notes carry a number that tells you which octave they're in. Middle C, near the center of a piano, is C4. The number goes up by one at every C.

rows.source: A keyboard's black keys come in groups of two and three. They're your map. C is the white key just left of each group of two.

rows.translation: ତିନିଟିଆ ଦଳର ଶେଷ ଦୁଇ କଳା ଚାବି ମଝିରେ A।

rows.source: Two names for the same pitch are called enharmonic. C♯ and D♭ are one key with two names. Which name you use depends on the key you're in.

rows.source: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on a line or in a space. The higher a note sits, the higher it sounds.

rows.translation: ଏହା ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ରେ ଅଧିକ ଉପରେ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ ଅଧିକ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Moving up one letter moves from a line to the next space, or from a space to the next line. Notes on neighboring lines are two letters apart.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉପରକୁ ଗଲେ ରେଖାରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ବା ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ରେଖାକୁ ଯାଏ। ପାଖାପାଖି ରେଖାର ସ୍ୱର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ବ୍ୟବଧାନରେ ଅଛି।

rows.source: A note on a line moves up one letter. Where does it land?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ରେଖା ଉପରର ସ୍ୱର ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରନାମ ଉଠିଲେ କେଉଁଠି ପହଞ୍ଚେ?

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Letters alternate: line, space, line, space.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-1 “Lines and spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରନାମ କ୍ରମେ ବଦଳେ: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The treble clef, or G clef, curls around the second line from the bottom. That line is the G above middle C. Higher instruments and voices read it.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ବା G କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ରେଖା ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲିଛି। ସେହି ରେଖା ମଧ୍ୟ C ର ଉପର G। ଉଚ୍ଚ ସ୍ୱରର ବାଦ୍ୟ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ପାଇଁ ଏହା ପଢ଼ାଯାଏ।

rows.source: Which note is on the second line of the treble staff?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ରେଖାରେ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଅଛି?

rows.source: The treble clef curls around that line to mark G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: G ଚିହ୍ନାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ସେହି ରେଖା ଚାରିପାଖରେ ବୁଲିଛି।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · title

identity_decision.reason: Mnemonic must preserve E G B D F word initials, explicitly explained in adjacent Odia teaching prose.

rows.source: From bottom to top, the treble staff's lines are E, G, B, D, F. Remember them as Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ରେଖାଗୁଡ଼ିକ E, G, B, D, F। Every Good Boy Does Fine ର ଆଦ୍ୟକ୍ଷର ଭାବେ ମନେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The bottom line is E, the Every of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳ ରେଖା E, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Every।

rows.source: The middle line is B, the Boy of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମଝି ରେଖା B, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Boy।

rows.source: The top line is F, the Fine of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଉପର ରେଖା F, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Fine।

rows.source: The fourth line up is D, the Does of Every Good Boy Does Fine.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ରେଖା D, Every Good Boy Does Fine ର Does।

rows.source: Play or sing the bottom three lines: E, G, B.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-2 “Treble clef lines” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତଳ ତିନି ରେଖା ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: E, G, B।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The four spaces of the treble staff spell a word from bottom to top: F, A, C, E. The spaces spell FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଚାରି ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଏକ ଶବ୍ଦ ଗଢ଼େ: F, A, C, E। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରେ FACE ଲେଖାହୁଏ।

rows.source: The bottom space is F, the first letter of FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ F, FACE ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅକ୍ଷର।

rows.source: The third space up is C: F, A, C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ C: F, A, C।

rows.source: The second space up is A: F, A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ A: F, A।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put them together and the staff climbs E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F: line, space, line, space, all the way up.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏକାଠି କଲେ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍ E, F, G, A, B, C, D, E, F ରେ ଉଠେ: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ଉପର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ।

rows.source: The top space is E, the last letter of FACE.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଉପର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ E, FACE ର ଶେଷ ଅକ୍ଷର।

rows.source: The second line up is G, where the treble clef curls.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ରେଖା G, ଯେଉଁଠି ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ବୁଲିଛି।

rows.source: Play or sing the spaces from bottom to top: F, A, C, E.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-3 “Treble clef spaces” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନର ସ୍ୱର ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: F, A, C, E।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: When a note goes above or below the staff, short extra lines called ledger lines extend it. Middle C sits on one ledger line just below the treble staff.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପରେ ବା ତଳେ ଗଲେ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖା ନାମକ ଛୋଟ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ରେଖା ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌କୁ ବଢ଼ାଏ। ମଧ୍ୟ C ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ତଳେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

rows.source: One ledger line below the treble staff is middle C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ C।

rows.source: D hangs in the space just below the bottom line.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: D ସବୁଠୁ ତଳ ରେଖାର ଠିକ୍ ତଳ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରହେ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Above the top line, the pattern keeps going. G sits just above the top line, and A sits on the first ledger line above.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସବୁଠୁ ଉପର ରେଖା ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଚାଲେ। G ସେହି ରେଖାର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ, A ତାହା ଉପରର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

rows.source: One ledger line above the treble staff is A.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ A।

rows.source: Count down: middle C on the first ledger line, B below it, A on the second ledger line.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳକୁ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାହା ତଳେ B, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ A।

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then D and E, climbing from the ledger line onto the staff.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-4 “Ledger lines and middle C” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାପରେ D ଓ E ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରୁ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌କୁ ଉଠି।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Low instruments and voices read the bass clef, or F clef. Its two dots surround the fourth line up, marking the F below middle C.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ସ୍ୱରର ବାଦ୍ୟ ଓ କଣ୍ଠ ବେସ୍ ବା F କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତି। ଏହାର ଦୁଇ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତଳୁ ଚତୁର୍ଥ ରେଖାର ଦୁଇ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ରହି, ମଧ୍ୟ C ର ତଳ F କୁ ଚିହ୍ନାଏ।

rows.source: Which note do the bass clef's dots mark?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ର ବିନ୍ଦୁ କେଉଁ ସ୍ୱର ଚିହ୍ନାଏ?

rows.source: The bass clef is the F clef: its dots frame the F line.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍ ହେଉଛି F କ୍ଲେଫ୍: ଏହାର ବିନ୍ଦୁ F ରେଖାର ଦୁଇ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ଅଛି।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · title

identity_decision.reason: Mnemonic preserves G B D F A initials for bass staff lines, with translated surrounding instruction.

rows.source: The bass staff's lines, bottom to top, are G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always. The spaces are A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ରେଖା ତଳୁ ଉପରକୁ G, B, D, F, A: Good Boys Do Fine Always। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ A, C, E, G: All Cows Eat Grass।

rows.source: The bottom line of the bass staff is G, the Good of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ରେଖା G, Good Boys Do Fine Always ର Good।

rows.source: The second space up is C: All Cows.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ତଳୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ C: All Cows।

rows.source: The top line of the bass staff is A, the Always of Good Boys Do Fine Always.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ରେଖା A, Good Boys Do Fine Always ର Always।

rows.source: Where is middle C in bass clef?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: On a ledger line above the staff
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Middle C sits one ledger line above the bass staff, and one below the treble staff.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C ବେସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ଉପର ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ, ଟ୍ରେବଲ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଫ୍‌ର ତଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖାରେ ରହେ।

rows.source: Play or sing the bass clef spaces: A, C, E, G.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · lesson thy-3-5 “Bass clef basics” · step 8 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ର ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ: A, C, E, G।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · title
Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lines, spaces, ledger lines and both clefs. Use your memory sentences, then try to recognize each note at a glance.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରେଖା, ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ, ଲେଜର୍ ରେଖା ଓ ଦୁଇ କ୍ଲେଫ୍। ମନେରଖିବା ବାକ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ ଦେଖିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଚିହ୍ନିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The third space up in bass clef is E: All Cows Eat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 8 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବେସ୍ କ୍ଲେଫ୍‌ରେ ତଳୁ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ E: All Cows Eat।

rows.source: Play or sing middle C, then E, G, and the C in the third space.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 3 · challenge thy-3-6 “Staff reading challenge” · step 9 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ମଧ୍ୟ C, ତାପରେ E, G ଓ ତୃତୀୟ ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନର C ବଜାନ୍ତୁ ବା ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Note values from whole to sixteenth, dots and rests, and the meters 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 “Rhythm and time” · unit summary
rows.translation: ହୋଲ୍‌ରୁ ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଅବଧି, ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଓ ବିରାମ, ଏବଂ 4/4, 3/4 ଓ 6/8 ମାତ୍ରାବିନ୍ୟାସ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. Beats are grouped into bars, also called measures. In most music, each bar holds four beats.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମାତ୍ରା ହେଉଛି ସେହି ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ, ଯାହା ସହ ପାଦ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତି। ମାତ୍ରା ମିଶି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ହୁଏ, ଯାହାକୁ ବାର୍ ବା ମେଜର୍ (measure) କୁହାଯାଏ। ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା ଥାଏ।

corrections.reason: Disambiguate the retained English bar/measure synonym lesson from major, which uses the same Odia transliteration elsewhere. Parenthetical original English is a taught term, not untranslated prose.

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Count each bar out loud: 1, 2, 3, 4. Beat 1, the downbeat, usually feels strongest. Lean into it a little.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଜୋରରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ: 1, 2, 3, 4। ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସବୁଠୁ ଜୋର ଲାଗେ। ସେଥିରେ ଟିକେ ଅଧିକ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: What's another word for a bar?

Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar and measure mean the same thing.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବାର୍ ଓ ମେଜର୍ (measure) ଉଭୟର ଅର୍ଥ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ।

rows.translation: କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରା ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସବୁଠୁ ଜୋର ଲାଗେ?

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1, the downbeat, starts each bar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-1 “Beats and bars” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ ମାତ୍ରା 1 ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A note's shape tells you how long it lasts. In a four-beat bar, a whole note lasts all four beats, a half note two, and a quarter note one.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରଲିପିର ଆକାର ସ୍ୱର କେତେ ସମୟ ରହିବ କୁହେ। ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି, ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ଓ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

rows.source: How many beats does a half note last?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Two half notes fill a four-beat bar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଦୁଇ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ।

rows.source: How many quarter notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେତୋଟି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଭରେ?

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, so four fill the bar.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ଚାରିଟିରେ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A whole note lasts four beats, a half note two, a quarter note one.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା, ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ, କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar can mix values, as long as they add up. A half note plus two quarter notes fills four beats: 2 + 1 + 1.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-2 “Whole, half and quarter notes” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅବଧିର ଯୋଗ ଠିକ୍ ଥିଲେ ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଭିନ୍ନ ଅବଧି ମିଶିପାରେ। ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ସହ ଦୁଇ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା ଭରେ: 2 + 1 + 1।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · title

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Count them 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and, saying and between the beats.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଧା ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି। 1 ଓ 2 ଓ 3 ଓ 4 ଓ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ମାତ୍ରା ମଝିରେ “ଓ” କହି।

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A sixteenth note lasts a quarter of a beat, so four fit in each beat. Count them 1 e and a, 2 e and a.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରାର ଏକ ଚତୁର୍ଥାଂଶ ରହେ, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାରିଟି। 1 ଇ ଓ ଆ, 2 ଇ ଓ ଆ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes equal one quarter note?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: କେତୋଟି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗୋଟିଏ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ସହ ସମାନ?

rows.source: A quarter note is one beat, and four sixteenths fit in a beat.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା; ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଚାରି ସିକ୍ସଟିନ୍ଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ରହେ।

rows.source: How many eighth notes fill a bar of four beats?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେତୋଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍‌ରେ ଭରେ?

rows.source: Two per beat, four beats: eight eighth notes.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-3 “Eighth and sixteenth notes” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଦୁଇଟି, ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା: ଆଠଟି ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A dot after a note adds half its value. A half note lasts two beats, so a dotted half lasts three. A dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱର ପରର ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତାହାର ଅବଧିର ଅଧା ଯୋଡ଼େ। ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରା, ତେଣୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ ହାଫ୍ ତିନି। ବିନ୍ଦୁଯୁକ୍ତ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ଦେଢ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ।

rows.source: Half of two is one, so the dot adds one beat: 2 + 1 = 3.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଦୁଇର ଅଧା ଏକ, ତେଣୁ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ଯୋଡ଼େ: 2 + 1 = 3।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: A rest is a measured silence. Each note value has a matching rest: a quarter rest lasts one beat, a half rest two. Keep counting through them.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ବିରାମ ମାପା ନୀରବତା। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଅବଧିର ସମାନ ବିରାମ ଅଛି: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ବିରାମ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା, ହାଫ୍ ବିରାମ ଦୁଇ। ସେଥିରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A quarter is one beat; the dot adds half of that.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା; ବିନ୍ଦୁ ତାହାର ଅଧା ଯୋଡ଼େ।

rows.source: A four-beat bar has a half note and a quarter note. What fills the gap?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଓ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଅଛି। ଖାଲି ସ୍ଥାନ କ’ଣ ଭରିବ?

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: 2 + 1 = 3, so one beat is left: a quarter rest.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-4 “Dots and rests” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: 2 + 1 = 3, ତେଣୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ବାକି: କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ବିରାମ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · title
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The two stacked numbers at the start of a piece are the time signature. The top number counts beats per bar. The bottom shows which note gets one beat: 4 means a quarter note.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରଚନାର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଉପର-ତଳ ଥିବା ଦୁଇ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନ। ଉପର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର ମାତ୍ରା ଗଣେ। ତଳ ସଂଖ୍ୟା କେଉଁ ନୋଟ୍ ଏକ ମାତ୍ରା ପାଏ କୁହେ: 4 ଅର୍ଥ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍।

rows.source: In 4/4, how many quarter-note beats are in a bar?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: 4/4 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍-ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ଅଛି?

rows.source: The top 4 means four beats; the bottom 4 makes each one a quarter note.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଉପର 4 ଅର୍ଥ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା; ତଳ 4 ପ୍ରତିଟିକୁ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ କରେ।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 3/4, each bar holds three quarter-note beats. Count 1, 2, 3, with the weight on 1. It's the lilt of a waltz.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 3/4 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍-ନୋଟ୍ ମାତ୍ରା ଥାଏ। 1 ରେ ଜୋର ଦେଇ 1, 2, 3 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍‌ର ଦୋଳନ।

rows.source: Which time signature is a waltz usually in?
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍ ସାଧାରଣତଃ କେଉଁ ତାଳ ଚିହ୍ନରେ ଥାଏ?

Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: In 6/8, each bar holds six eighth notes in two groups of three. It feels like two big beats, each split in three: 1 2 3, 4 5 6.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 6/8 ରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ତିନିଟି ଲେଖାଏଁ ଦୁଇ ଦଳରେ। ଏହା ଦୁଇ ବଡ଼ ମାତ୍ରା ପରି ଲାଗେ, ପ୍ରତିଟି ତିନି ଭାଗରେ: 1 2 3, 4 5 6।

rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction
Music Theory · Unit 4 · lesson thy-4-5 “Time signatures” · step 6 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A triad is three notes stacked in thirds. Start on any note, skip a letter, take the next, skip again. C, skip D, E, skip F, G: C E G.

rows.source: A major triad has a major third on the bottom, four half steps, then a minor third on top. C E G is major. So are F A C and G B D.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-2 “Major and minor triads” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Flip the thirds and you get minor: a minor third on the bottom, then a major third. Lower the middle note of C major and you get C minor: C E♭ G.

rows.source: Musicians number a key's chords with Roman numerals: I for the chord on note 1, up to vii for note 7. Uppercase means major, lowercase minor, and ° diminished.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 7 · lesson thy-7-4 “Roman numerals” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସଙ୍ଗୀତଜ୍ଞମାନେ ମୂଳ ସ୍ୱରର କର୍ଡକୁ ରୋମାନ୍ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଦିଅନ୍ତି: ସ୍ୱର 1 ର କର୍ଡ ପାଇଁ I, ସ୍ୱର 7 ପାଇଁ vii ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ। ବଡ଼ ଅକ୍ଷର ମେଜର୍, ଛୋଟ ଅକ୍ଷର ମାଇନର୍ ଓ ° ଡିମିନିଶ୍ଡ ବୁଝାଏ।

rows.source: Every major key follows one pattern: I, ii, iii, IV, V, vi, vii°. In C major that's C, D minor, E minor, F, G, A minor and B diminished.

rows.translation: ଅଗଣିତ ଲୋକଗୀତ, ରକ୍ ଓ କଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ଗୀତ କେବଳ I, IV, V ତିନି କର୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ। C ମେଜର୍‌ରେ C, F, G। ମିଶି ସେମାନେ ସ୍କେଲ୍‌ର ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ଧାରଣ କରନ୍ତି।

rows.source: I feels like home. IV moves away. V builds tension that pulls back to I. That trip, out and back again, shapes a huge number of songs.

rows.source: This four-chord loop runs under a huge number of pop songs. In C major it's C, G, A minor, F. The minor vi adds a touch of shade before IV lifts back toward home.

rows.source: The 12-bar blues is a chord plan, twelve bars long, behind countless blues, rock and jazz tunes. It uses I, IV and V, often all as dominant seventh chords for a bluesy edge.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-4 “The 12-bar blues” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 12-ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ବାର ଆବର୍ତ୍ତର କର୍ଡ ଯୋଜନା, ଯାହା ଅଗଣିତ ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍, ରକ୍ ଓ ଜାଜ୍ ସୁରର ଆଧାର। ଏଥିରେ I, IV, V ବ୍ୟବହାର ହୁଏ; ବ୍ଲୁଜ୍ ରଙ୍ଗ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସବୁ ଡୋମିନାଣ୍ଟ ସେଭେନ୍ଥ କର୍ଡ।

rows.source: Four bars of I. Two of IV, two of I. One of V, one of IV, two of I. Then it repeats. In A: A7 four times, D7 twice, A7 twice, E7, D7, A7 twice.

rows.translation: I ର ଚାରି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ। IV ର ଦୁଇ, I ର ଦୁଇ। V ର ଗୋଟିଏ, IV ର ଗୋଟିଏ, I ର ଦୁଇ। ପୁଣି ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି। A ରେ: A7 ଚାରିଥର, D7 ଦୁଇଥର, A7 ଦୁଇଥର, E7, D7, A7 ଦୁଇଥର।

rows.source: A cadence is the chord move that ends a phrase, like punctuation. V to I is the strongest, a full stop. It's called an authentic cadence.
rows.context: Music Theory · Unit 8 · lesson thy-8-5 “Cadences” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଯେଉଁ କର୍ଡ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାକ୍ୟକୁ ଶେଷ କରେ, ତାହା ସମାପନ ସ୍ୱରକ୍ରମ—ବିରାମଚିହ୍ନ ପରି। V ରୁ I ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୃଢ଼, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣଚ୍ଛେଦ ପରି। ଏହାକୁ ଅଥେଣ୍ଟିକ୍ ସମାପନ କୁହାଯାଏ।

rows.source: IV to I is a plagal cadence, the soft amen at the end of many hymns. Stopping on V is a half cadence, like a comma. V to vi is deceptive: you expect home and get a surprise.

rows.translation: IV ରୁ I ହେଉଛି ପ୍ଲେଗାଲ୍ ସମାପନ, ଅନେକ ସ୍ତୁତିଗୀତ ଶେଷର ମୃଦୁ ଆମେନ୍। V ରେ ଅଟକିବା ହାଫ୍ ସମାପନ, କମା ପରି। V ରୁ vi ଡିସେପ୍ଟିଭ୍: ମୂଳ କର୍ଡ ଆଶା କରି ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ମୋଡ଼ ପାଆନ୍ତି।

rows.source: The beat is a steady pulse
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: The beat is the steady pulse you tap your foot to. It never rushes or drags, like footsteps on an easy walk. Every rhythm sits on top of it.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଯେଉଁ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ସହ ପାଦ ଥାପନ୍ତି, ତାହା ମାତ୍ରା। ସହଜ ଚାଲିବାର ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପରି ଏହା ଆଗୁଆ ବା ପଛୁଆ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ପ୍ରତି ଛନ୍ଦ ଏହା ଉପରେ ଗଢ଼ିଉଠେ।

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Hold your fingertip just above the screen and tap each time the click sounds. Let it bounce off the glass like a drumstick. Aim to land with the click, not after it.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-1 “Find the pulse” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିର ଟିପକୁ ସ୍କ୍ରିନ୍‌ର ଠିକ୍ ଉପରେ ରଖି ପ୍ରତି କ୍ଲିକ୍‌ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଡ୍ରମ୍ ଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ପରି କାଚରୁ ଫେରି ଉଠୁ। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ଛୁଇଁବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ନୁହେଁ।

rows.source: Most music groups beats in fours. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 out loud with the click, then start again at 1. Saying the numbers helps your hands keep time.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଙ୍ଗୀତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରାର ଦଳ ଥାଏ। କ୍ଲିକ୍ ସହ ଜୋରରେ 1, 2, 3, 4 ଗଣି ପୁଣି 1 ରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସଂଖ୍ୟା କହିଲେ ହାତ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟ ରଖିପାରେ।

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: A bar is one group of beats. Here each bar holds four beats, written 4/4. Beat 1 starts every bar, so lean on it a little as you count.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ହେଉଛି ମାତ୍ରାର ଗୋଟିଏ ଦଳ। ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଚାରି ମାତ୍ରା, 4/4 ଭାବେ ଲେଖାଯାଏ। ମାତ୍ରା 1 ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ଗଣିବାବେଳେ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The strong click is beat 1. How many beats are in each bar?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍‌ଟି ମାତ୍ରା 1। ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ କେତେ ମାତ୍ରା?

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-2 “Count to four” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ କେଉଁ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ?

rows.source: A note that lasts one beat is a quarter note. Four of them fill a bar of 4/4, so tapping on every beat means tapping quarter notes.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା ରହୁଥିବା ସ୍ୱର କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଚାରିଟି ମିଶି 4/4 ର ଏକ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଭରେ। ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବା ମାନେ କ୍ୱାର୍ଟର୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରିବା।

corrections.reason: Use explicit Western duration names consistent with reviewed earlier lessons; no fractional-pitch ambiguity.

rows.source: Now tap only on 1 and 3. Each tap is a half note, two beats long. Keep counting all four; the beats you skip still happen.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-3 “Quarter notes and longer” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏବେ କେବଳ 1 ଓ 3 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ଦୁଇ ମାତ୍ରାର ହାଫ୍ ନୋଟ୍। ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଗଣୁଥାନ୍ତୁ; ଛାଡ଼ିଥିବା ମାତ୍ରା ମଧ୍ୟ ଚାଲିଥାଏ।

corrections.reason: Use explicit Western duration names consistent with reviewed earlier lessons; no fractional-pitch ambiguity.

rows.translation: ହୋଲ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ମାତ୍ରା ରହେ। 1 ରେ ଥରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରି ମନେମନେ 2, 3, 4 ଗଣନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ 1 ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଆସେ।

rows.source: Tempo is the speed of the beat
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Tempo is how fast the beat goes, counted in beats per minute, or bpm. At 60 bpm the beat comes once a second, like a clock.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ମାତ୍ରା କେତେ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଚାଲେ, ତାହା ଲୟର ବେଗ। ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରତି ମିନିଟ୍‌ର ମାତ୍ରା ବା bpm ରେ ଗଣାଯାଏ। 60 bpm ରେ ଘଣ୍ଟା ପରି ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା।

rows.source: At 60 bpm, how often does the beat come?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: 60 bpm ରେ କେତେ ସମୟରେ ମାତ୍ରା ଆସେ?

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 1 · lesson rhy-1-4 “Tempo” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: 60 ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 60 ମାତ୍ରା ମାନେ ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ରା।

rows.source: Faster tempos need less effort, not more. Keep your hand loose and tap from the knuckle, not the wrist or shoulder.

rows.translation: ଦ୍ରୁତ ଲୟରେ ଅଧିକ ନୁହେଁ, କମ୍ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଦରକାର। ହାତ ଢିଲା ରଖି ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଗଣ୍ଠିରୁ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, କଚଟି ବା କାନ୍ଧରୁ ନୁହେଁ।

rows.source: In 3/4 time each bar has three beats: ONE, two, three. It's the waltz. Count 1, 2, 3 and lean on 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-1 “Waltz time: 3/4” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: 3/4 ର ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ତିନି ମାତ୍ରା: ଏକ, ଦୁଇ, ତିନି—ଏକରେ ଜୋର। ଏହା ୱାଲ୍ଟ୍ଜ୍। 1, 2, 3 ଗଣି 1 କୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A half note fills two of the three beats. Tap 1, count 2, tap 3. It feels like the big step and small step of a waltz.

rows.source: An accent is a note played stronger than the ones around it. Move the accents and the feel changes, even when every note stays the same.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଆଖପାଖର ସ୍ୱରଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଜୋରରେ ବଜାଇଥିବା ସ୍ୱରରେ ଆକ୍ସେଣ୍ଟ ବା ଜୋର ଥାଏ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ସମାନ ରହିଲେ ବି ଜୋରର ସ୍ଥାନ ବଦଳାଇଲେ ଅନୁଭୂତି ବଦଳେ।

rows.source: Count all eight eighths and tap just the accents: 1, the "and" of 2, and 4. This 3-3-2 pattern drives a lot of pop and Latin music.

rows.translation: ଆଠଟିଯାକ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍ ଗଣି କେବଳ ଜୋର ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍: 1, 2 ର “ଓ”, ଏବଂ 4। ଏହି 3-3-2 ଢାଞ୍ଚା ଅନେକ ପପ୍ ଓ ଲାଟିନ୍ ସଙ୍ଗୀତକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନିଏ।

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ରକ୍, ପପ୍ ଓ ସୋଲ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 2 ଓ 4 ରେ ଜୋର ଦିଅନ୍ତି। ଏହା ବ୍ୟାକ୍‌ବିଟ୍। ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ଗଣି ସ୍ନେୟାର୍ ଡ୍ରମ୍ ପରି କେବଳ 2 ଓ 4 ରେ ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: The first click is beat 1. Where are the strong clicks?
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମ କ୍ଲିକ୍ ମାତ୍ରା 1। ଜୋର କ୍ଲିକ୍ କେଉଁଠି?

rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · lesson rhy-6-4 “Accents” · step 8 (listen) · quiz answer
Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · title

rows.source: This challenge moves between meters and accents. Before each tap step, count one bar under your breath to find beat 1.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଏହି ଆହ୍ୱାନରେ ମାତ୍ରା ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଓ ଜୋର ବଦଳେ। ପ୍ରତି ଟ୍ୟାପ୍ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ମନେମନେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆବର୍ତ୍ତ ଗଣି ମାତ୍ରା 1 ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Six eighth notes per bar, felt in two groups of three.
rows.context: Rhythm · Unit 6 · challenge rhy-6-5 “Every meter” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ପ୍ରତି ଆବର୍ତ୍ତରେ ଛଅ ଏଇଥ୍ ନୋଟ୍, ତିନିଟିଆ ଦୁଇ ଦଳର ଅନୁଭୂତି।

corrections.reason: Use established explicit Western duration terminology.

rows.context: Singing course · title

rows.source: Find your voice and sing in tune
rows.context: Singing course · course subtitle
rows.translation: ନିଜ କଣ୍ଠ ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ଠିକ୍ ସୁରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, hold your first steady note and sing a song.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 “Finding your voice” · unit summary
rows.translation: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ, ତଳ ପେଟ ଯାଏଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଥମ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଧରି ଗୀତ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees soft. Let your shoulders drop and your head float up, as if a string lifts it. Keep your jaw loose.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପାଦ ଦୁଇଟିକୁ ନିତମ୍ବର ପ୍ରସ୍ଥ ଅନୁସାରେ ଫାଙ୍କ କରି, ଆଣ୍ଠୁ ଢିଲା ରଖି ଠିଆ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ। କାନ୍ଧ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ସୂତା ଉଠାଉଛି ପରି ଭାବନ୍ତୁ। ହନୁ ଢିଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest a hand on your belly and breathe in slowly. Your belly and lower ribs widen while your shoulders stay still. That low breath powers your voice.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପେଟରେ ହାତ ରଖି ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପେଟ ଓ ତଳ ପଞ୍ଜରା ପ୍ରସାରିତ ହେବ, କାନ୍ଧ ସ୍ଥିର ରହିବ। ଏହି ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ଶକ୍ତି ଦିଏ।

rows.source: When you breathe in to sing, what should move?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଗାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଲେ କ’ଣ ଚଳିବା ଉଚିତ?

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A low breath widens your ribs and belly. Lifting your shoulders tightens your neck and throat.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ପଞ୍ଜରା ଓ ପେଟ ପ୍ରସାରିତ କରେ। କାନ୍ଧ ଉଠାଇଲେ ବେକ ଓ ଗଳା ଟାଣ ହୁଏ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Timbre listens for the note's name, so a C sung low or high both count. Pick the octave that feels easy, never strained.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: Timbre ସ୍ୱରର ନାମ ଶୁଣେ, ତେଣୁ ତଳ ବା ଉଚ୍ଚ C ଉଭୟ ଗ୍ରହଣଯୋଗ୍ୟ। ଯେଉଁ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍ ସହଜ ଲାଗେ ତାହା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, କେବେ ଜୋର କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।

rows.source: Breathe low, then sing C on "ah" in a comfortable octave. Hold it steady.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଇ ସହଜ ଅକ୍ଟେଭ୍‌ରେ “ଆ” କହି C ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ଥିର ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Once more: stand tall, breathe low, and let the note ring.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-1 “Stand and breathe” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ପୁଣି ଥରେ: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଗୁଞ୍ଜିବାକୁ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: To sustain is to hold a note at one steady pitch. Let the air out slowly and evenly, like fogging a mirror without stopping.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଧରିବା ମାନେ ଏକ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ରଖିବା। ନଅଟକି ଆଇନାରେ ବାଷ୍ପ କରିବା ପରି ଧୀରେ ଓ ସମାନ ଭାବେ ବାୟୁ ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing C on "ah" and hold it steady until it locks in.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: “ଆ” କହି C ଗାଇ ସୁର ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଧରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Your note wobbles and fades. What helps most?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱର ଦୋଳି କମିଯାଉଛି। କ’ଣ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ?

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Steady air makes a steady note. Extra volume and tension make it harder to control.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ସ୍ଥିର ବାୟୁ ସ୍ଥିର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ। ଅଧିକ ଜୋର ଓ ଟାଣ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣକୁ କଠିନ କରେ।

rows.source: Now E. Same low breath, same easy "ah."
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏବେ E। ସେହି ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ, ସେହି ସହଜ “ଆ”।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Sing "ah" with your jaw dropped and the tip of your tongue resting behind your lower teeth. The sound flows out instead of getting squeezed.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ହନୁ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ି, ଜିଭ ଟିପ୍ ତଳ ଦାନ୍ତ ପଛରେ ରଖି “ଆ” ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ। ଶବ୍ଦ ଚାପି ନହୋଇ ସହଜରେ ବାହାରେ।

rows.source: G this time. Drop your jaw and keep the "ah" open.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 6 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏଥର G। ହନୁ ତଳକୁ ଛାଡ଼ି “ଆ” ଖୋଲା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-2 “Hold one note” · step 7 (along) · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · title
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Matching pitch means singing the same note you hear. Listen, imagine the note for a moment, then sing softly and adjust until it settles.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ମିଳାଇବା ମାନେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ଗାଇବା। ଶୁଣି କ୍ଷଣେ ମନରେ ସ୍ୱରଟି ଭାବନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ଯାଏଁ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Sing E softly, then adjust until it settles.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: E ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ସ୍ଥିର ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଜାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Flat means under the target pitch; sharp means over it. If you're flat, lift a little. If you're sharp, ease down. Small moves work best.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ; ଉଚ୍ଚ ମାନେ ଉପରେ। ନିମ୍ନ ହେଲେ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ, ଉଚ୍ଚ ହେଲେ ଧୀରେ ତଳକୁ ଆଣନ୍ତୁ। ଛୋଟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଭଲ କାମ କରେ।

rows.source: Timbre says you're flat. What do you do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: Timbre କହୁଛି ସ୍ୱର ନିମ୍ନ। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Flat means under the note, so lift the pitch slightly.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ନିମ୍ନ ମାନେ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ତଳେ, ତେଣୁ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Two notes this time: D, then G. Take a breath between them.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-3 “Match a pitch” · step 7 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: ଏଥର ଦୁଇ ସ୍ୱର: D, ପରେ G। ମଝିରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · title

corrections.reason: Gentle/quiet denotes intensity, not tempo.

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Humming with your lips closed is a gentle warm-up. You should feel a light buzz on your lips and nose. Keep it soft and easy.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଓଠ ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାଇବା ମୃଦୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି। ଓଠ ଓ ନାକରେ ହାଲୁକା କମ୍ପନ ଅନୁଭବ ହେବା ଉଚିତ। ମୃଦୁ ଓ ସହଜ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Hum C, E and G, one at a time. Keep it light.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: C, E, G ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଟିଏ କରି ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣାନ୍ତୁ। ହାଲୁକା ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter like a motorboat, then add your voice. It keeps your throat relaxed while your voice wakes up.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଓଠ ଢିଲା ବନ୍ଦ କରି ଫୁଙ୍କନ୍ତୁ, ଯେପରି ମୋଟରବୋଟ୍ ଭଳି କମ୍ପେ; ପରେ କଣ୍ଠସ୍ୱର ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଠ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେବାବେଳେ ଏହା ଗଳାକୁ ଢିଲା ରଖେ।

rows.source: Lip trill on G, E, then C. If your lips stop, press your cheeks lightly.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: G, E, ପରେ C ରେ ଓଠ କମ୍ପନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଓଠ ଅଟକିଲେ ଗାଲକୁ ହାଲୁକା ଚାପନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A note feels tight or scratchy. What do you do?
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ୱରରେ ଟାଣ ବା ଖରଖର ଲାଗୁଛି। କ’ଣ କରିବେ?

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Stop, rest, and try it softer
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
rows.translation: ଅଟକି ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେଇ ମୃଦୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବେ

rows.source: Strain is a signal to ease off. Rest, sip some water, and come back lighter.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଟାଣ ଲାଗିବା ମାନେ ଜୋର କମାଇବାର ସଙ୍କେତ। ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନେଇ ଅଳ୍ପ ପାଣି ପିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପୁଣି ହାଲୁକା ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।

rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · lesson voc-1-4 “Warm up gently” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Stand tall, breathe low, and start each note softly. Rest between steps if your voice feels tired.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 1 · challenge voc-1-5 “First notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ସିଧା ଠିଆ ହୋଇ ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ମୃଦୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। କଣ୍ଠ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ଲାଗିଲେ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଝିରେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: E, then G. Hear each one before you sing it.

rows.source: Dynamics are how loud or soft you sing. Get louder with more breath energy, not by squeezing your throat. The pitch should stay put.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଡାଇନାମିକ୍ସ ମାନେ କେତେ ଜୋର ବା ମୃଦୁ ଗାଆନ୍ତି। ଗଳା କସି ନୁହେଁ, ଅଧିକ ଶ୍ୱାସଶକ୍ତିରେ ଜୋର ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସ୍ଥିର ରହିବା ଉଚିତ।

rows.source: Sing E softly, then louder on the same pitch.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: E ମୃଦୁ ଗାଇ ପରେ ସେହି ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତାରେ ଜୋରରେ ଗାଆନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: As you get louder, what can happen to pitch?

rows.source: Extra push tends to raise the pitch, and very soft notes can sag flat. Watch the note either way.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ଅଧିକ ଚାପରେ ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ବଢ଼ିପାରେ, ଅତି ମୃଦୁ ସ୍ୱର ତଳକୁ ଖସିପାରେ। ଉଭୟ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ସ୍ୱର ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A swell grows from soft to louder and back on one breath. Start quietly, grow gently, then fade, all on the same pitch.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଗୋଟିଏ ଶ୍ୱାସରେ ମୃଦୁରୁ ଜୋର, ପୁଣି ମୃଦୁ କରନ୍ତୁ। ମୃଦୁ ଭାବେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ନରମଭାବେ ବଢ଼ାନ୍ତୁ, ପରେ କମାନ୍ତୁ; ସ୍ୱରୋଚ୍ଚତା ସମାନ ରହୁ।

corrections.reason: Gentle/quiet denotes intensity, not tempo.

rows.source: Swell on G: soft, louder, soft. Keep it centered.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-3 “Loud and soft” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise
rows.translation: G ର ଜୋର ବଢ଼ାଇ କମାନ୍ତୁ: ମୃଦୁ, ଜୋର, ମୃଦୁ। ସୁର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: A short warm-up eases your voice in: breathe low, hum, lip trill, then sing a scale. Start in the middle of your range and stay comfortable.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ଅଳ୍ପ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି କଣ୍ଠକୁ ସହଜ କରେ: ନିମ୍ନ ଶ୍ୱାସ, ଗୁଣୁଗୁଣା, ଓଠ କମ୍ପନ, ପରେ ସ୍କେଲ୍ ଗାୟନ। ନିଜ ସ୍ୱରସୀମାର ମଝିରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ସହଜ ରହନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Your voice feels tired after practice. What's best?

rows.translation: ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ପରେ କଣ୍ଠ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ଲାଗୁଛି। କ’ଣ ଭଲ?

rows.source: Rest helps a tired voice recover. If hoarseness lingers for a few weeks, check with a doctor.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · lesson voc-6-4 “Your warm-up routine” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
rows.translation: ବିଶ୍ରାମ କ୍ଲାନ୍ତ କଣ୍ଠକୁ ସୁସ୍ଥ କରେ। କଣ୍ଠ ବସିଯିବା କିଛି ସପ୍ତାହ ରହିଲେ ଡାକ୍ତରଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।

rows.source: Warm up first. Then hold each note steady, shape it soft and loud, and breathe before you run out.
rows.context: Singing · Unit 6 · challenge voc-6-5 “Control check” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
rows.translation: ପ୍ରଥମେ କଣ୍ଠ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରନ୍ତୁ। ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱର ସ୍ଥିର ଧରି ମୃଦୁ ଓ ଜୋର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଶ୍ୱାସ ସରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

rows.translation: ଭିବ୍ରାଟୋ ସ୍ୱର ଚାରିପାଖରେ ମୃଦୁ, ସମାନ ତରଙ୍ଗ, ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ କିଛିଥର।
